source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
reference: "Kamöe jinoe na tikoih umu 4 buleuen nyang hana diabetes nyang awaijih saket diabetes," geutamah le gobnyan.
hypothesis: "Jinoenyoe kamoe na tikus nyang meu umu 4 buleuen nyang hana diabetes nyang kalheh diabetes", tambahnya.

source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, profesor kedokteran bak Universitas Dalhousie di Halifax, Nova Scotia ngôn keupala divisi klinis ngôn ilmiah dari Asosiasi Diabetes Kanada geupeuingat bahwa penelitian nyoe mantöng lam masa nyang keuphôn.
hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, profesor kedokteran di Universitas Dalhousie di Halifax, Nova Scotia dan ketua divisi klinis ngen ilmiah dari Asosiasi Diabetes Kanada meucen bahwa penelitian mantong na bak uroe awai jih.

source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
reference: Lagèe ladom ureuëng caröng laenjih, gobnyan ragu peukeuh peunyaket diabetes jeut puléh, sabab nyang jiteumèe nyoe hana meusangkot deungôn ureuëng nyang ka meupeunyaket diabetes jeunèh 1.
hypothesis: Lagee padum-padum ahli laen, jih skeptis tentang peu kheueh diabetes jeut di peupuléh, geuingat bahwa temuan nyo hana relevan untuk ureung nyang ka na diabetes tipe 1.

source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
reference: Bak uroe Senin, Sara Danius, sekretaris teutap Komite Nobel Sastra bak Akademi Swedia, geuumumkan ngôn bak mandum ureuëng lam masa program radio di Radio Sveriges di Swedia komite nyan, han jeuet meusambông deungôn Bob Dylan ngôn lansông teuntang keumenangan Hadiah Nobel 2016 lam Sastra, ka geupeutinggai usaha keu meusambông deungôn gobnyan.
hypothesis: Bak uroe Buleuen, Sara Danius, sekretaris tetap Komite Nobel untuk Sastra di Swedish Academy, geuumumkan secara terbuka seulama program radio di Sveriges Radio di Swedia komite nyan, hana hase meurumpok langsung ngon Bob Dylan tentang meunang Hadiah Nobel dalam Sastra 2016, ka geupeuplueng usaha untuk meurumpok ngon jih.

source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
reference: Danius kheun, "Jinoe kamöe hana meubuet sapeue. Lôn ka lôn talipun ngön lôn kirém email keu kolaborator gobnyan nyan paléng rab ngôn lôn teurimöng balah nyang paléng ruméh. Jinoe, nyan ka sep.
hypothesis: Danius geupeugah, "Sikeubit jih bak saát nyoe kamoe hana kamoe peubuet sapeue. Ulôn ka lôn peuhimbir dan lôn kirém email ubak peungawai gobnyan nyang paleng tô dan ka lôn teurimong jawaban nyang ramah. Keu saat nyoe, nyan ka seb".

source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
reference: Sigohlom gobnyan, CEO Ring, Jamie Siminoff, geukheun keu perusahaan phôn watèe bel pinto gobnyan han jeuet meudeungö dari keudèe gobnyan lam garasi gobnyan.
hypothesis: Phon awai, CEO Ring, Jamie Siminoff, geu peugah bahwa perusahaan nyan dimulai wate lon hana lon deungoe lon lon lon lon lon peugah bak toko di garasi.

source: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
reference: Gobnyan peugöt bel pinto WiFi, jikheun lé gobnyan.
hypothesis: Jih geupeudong saboh lonceng pintoe WiFi, kheun jih.

source: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
reference: Siminoff kheun hasé meukat geuék ‘oh lheuh piasan gobnyan bak thôn 2013 lam episode Shark Tank lam pat panel acara tula bri dana keu startup.
hypothesis: Siminoff geupeugah penjualan meutamah le lheuh penampilan 2013 jih lam saboh episode Shark Tank di pat panel acara hana jitem meubiaya startup nyan.

source: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
reference: Bak akhée 2017, Siminoff teuka bak saluran televisi beulanja QVC.
hypothesis: Bak akhe thon 2017, Siminoff geupeuleumah bak saluran televisi belanja QVC.

source: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
reference: Ring geuseuleuso cit gugatan ngôn peurusahaan keamanan lawan, ADT Corporation.
hypothesis: Ring cit geupeuseuleusoe peukara peukara bak perusahaan keamanan nyang bersaing, ADT Corporation.

source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
reference: Adakpih sabôh vaksin eksperimental deuhjih jeuet keu peukureuëng masa udép Ebola, sampöe jinoe, hana ubat nyang beutoi leumah jeut keu peuubat infeksi nyang na.
hypothesis: Sementara saboh vaksin eksperimen deuh jih mampu mengurangi kematian Ebola, sampoe saat nyoe, hana ubat yang jelas terbukti cocok untuk mengobati infeksi yang na.

source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
reference: Sabôh koktail antibodi, ZMapp, nyang awaijih peuleumah harapan lam lapangan nyan, teutapih studi formal jipeuleumah bahwa gunajih leubéh ubit nibak nyang tamita lam tatham mawot.
hypothesis: Saboh koktail antibodi, ZMapp, awai jih na peungharapan di lapangan, teutapi penelitian formal teuntang nyan na keuntungan yeng kureueng daripada yang di mita dalam mencegah kematian.

source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
reference: Lam ujoe PALM, ZMapp meutugah sebagoe nyang peutimang, nyang maknajih awak ilmuwan geungui nyan sebagoe asai keu geubandéng lhèe macam cara peuubat nyang laen nibak nyan.
hypothesis: Lam uji PALM, ZMapp ji peumeu'én seubagoe kontrol, ateuh ilmuwan ji peuguna seubagoe dasar dan ji peumeu'én lhee peubeda la'én keu jih.

source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
reference: Seunam AS dukong surat Komite Olimpiade Amerika Serikat ngôn teurimöng hai nyang bit jipeureulee le keuluwarga Olimpiade keu promosi mukim nyang aman keu bandum atlet kamöe.
hypothesis: USA Gymnastics geu dukong surat Komite Olimpiade Amerika Serikat dan geu terima kebutuhan mutlak keluarga Olimpiade untuk geu promosi lingkungan yang aman untuk mandum atlet geutanyoe.

source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
reference: Kamöe pih teurimöng yang jipeugah dari USOC bahwa hai nyang peunténg dari atlet ngôn klub kamöe, ngôn olahraga awaknyan, jeut leubéh get geupeutimang ngôn grak u keue deungôn perobahan nyang meumakna lam organisasi kamöe, nibak desertifikasi.
hypothesis: Kamoe setuju ngen pernyataan USOC bahwa kepentingan atlet dan klub geutanyoe, dan olahraga jih, jeut leubeh get dipeutimang le jih deungon maju deungen perubahan yang signifikan dalam organisasi geutanyoe, daripada decertification.

source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
reference: Seunam AS geudukong penyelidikan independen nyang jeuet geupeuleumah ngôn trang kiban brat jeuheut keu ukoenyang geupeujeulaih ngôn beuheu that le awak nyang seulamat dari Larry Nassar jeut han jitupeue ka treb that ngôn jiteurimöng meubagoe perubahan nyang peureulee ngôn beutoi.
hypothesis: USA Gymnastics mendukung penyelidikan independen yeng jeut meucet cahaya tentang cara penyalahgunaan proporsi yeng digambarkan seubalek jih le ureung nyang seulamat dari Larry Nassar jeut hana teutap keu jangka masa nyang panyang dan meukatu perubahan yang diperlukan dan tepat.

source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
reference: Seunam USA ngön USOC na tujuan nyang saban — peugöt olahraga seunam, ngön laenjih, beuaman mungken keu awak atlet keu beu sampöe u lumpöe awaknyan di mukim nyang aman, positif ngön meudaya.
hypothesis: USA Gymnastics ngen USOC na tujuan yang sama  untuk meuget olahraga gimnastics, ngen la'én, aman seucara mungken untuk atlet untuk meujak impian jih lam lingkungan yang aman, positif ngen meukapek.

source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
reference: Lam masa thôn 1960-an, Brzezinski keureuja keu John F. Kennedy sebagoe penasihat gobnyan ngôn alheuh nyan bak administrasi Lyndon B. Johnson.
hypothesis: Seulama thon 1960-an, Brzezinski geubantu John F. Kennedy seubagoe penasihat jih dan lheuh nyan administrasi Lyndon B. Johnson.

source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
reference: Lam peunileh 1976,gobnyan geubi nasihat bak Carter teuntang kebijakan luwa nanggroe, alheuh nyan meutugah sebagoe Penasihat Keuamanan Nasional (NSA) 1977-1981, geulanto Henry Kissinger.
hypothesis: Seulama pemilihan 1976 jih geu naseuhat Carter tentang kebijakan luar negeri, lheuh nyan geumilék seubagoe Peunaseuhat Keamanan Nasional (NSA) dari thon 1977 sampoe 1981, meurileh Henry Kissinger.

source: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
reference: Sebagoe NSA, gobnyan geubantu Carter lam geuuroh urusan donya ngôn diplomatis, lagèe Kesepakatan Camp David, 1978; normalisasi hubungan AS-Cina lam akhée 1970-an; Revolusi Iran, nyang peuseubab krisis drop ureuëng di Iran, 1979; ngôn invasi Soviet di Afghanistan, 1979.
hypothesis: Sebagai NSA, jih ka geubantu Carter dalam urusan donya secara diplomatik, lage Perjanjian Camp David, 1978; normalisasi hubungan AS China pike bak akhe thon 1970an; Revolusi Iran, nyang peulheueh krisis tawanan Iran, 1979; dan invasi Soviet di Afghanistan, 1979.

source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
reference: Film, nyang geupeleumah Ryan Gosling ngôn Emma Stone, teurimöng nominasi di bandum kategori utama.
hypothesis: Film nyan, na Ryan Gosling ngen Emma Stone, geuteurimong nominasi lam mandum kategori utama.

source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
reference: Gosling ngön Stone maséng-maséng teurimöng nominasi keu Aktor ngön Aktris nyang paléng get.
hypothesis: Gosling ngen Stone geuteurimong nominasi untuk Aktor Terbaik ngen Aktris seucara seucara seureuta.

source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
reference: Nominasi laen teumasok Gamba Nyang Paléng Get, Sutradara, Sinematografi, Desain Kostum, Edit Film, Skor Nyang Aseuli, Desain Produksi, Edit Su, Jampu Su ngôn Skenario Nyang Aseuli.
hypothesis: Nominasi laen na antara laen: Film Terbaik, Sutradara, Sinematografi, Desain Kostum, Pengedit Film, Skor Asli, Desain Produksi, Pengedit Suara, Penghiasan Suara dan Naskah Asli.

source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
reference: Dua bôh lagu dari film nyan, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) ngôn City of Stars, teurimöng nominasi keu lagu asli nyang paléng get. Studio Lionsgate teurimöng 26 nominasi — leubéh le dari studio nyang laen.
hypothesis: Dua lagu dari pilem nyan, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) dan City of Stars, jiteurimong nominasi untuk lagu asli terbaik. Studio Lionsgate geuteurimong 26 nominasi  leubeh dari studio laen.

source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
reference: Malam aleuhat, Presiden Amerika Serikat Donald Trump, lam sabôh pernyataan nyang geupeusampöe lésekretaris pers, geumumkan teuntra AS akan geupeutinggai Suriah.
hypothesis: Malam uroe Minggu, Presiden Amerika Serikat Donald Trump, lam saboh pernyataan nyang geupeutrok meulalu sekretaris pers, geuumumkan bahwa pasukan Amerika akan geutinggai Suriah.

source: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
reference: Pengumuman nyan geupeuget oh lheuh Trump geutalipun ngôn Presiden Turki Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
hypothesis: Pengumuman nyan geupeuget lheuh Trump na peumeurita bak telepon ngen Presiden Turki Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

source: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
reference: Turki neuk cok pulang cit kawai awak peujuang ISIS nyang geudrop, nyang meunurot pernyataan nyan, nanggroe- nanggroe Eropa ka geutulak keu geupeuwoe.
hypothesis: Turki akan juga mengambil alih penjaga pejuang ISIS yang ditangkap yang, menurut pernyataan nyan, bansa Eropa ka geutulak untuk geu pulang.

source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
reference: Nyoe kon sagai geuteuntèe bahwa nakeuh ladom dinosaurus na bulèe, bôhsabôh teori nyang ka meusyuhu, teutapih umumjih han jeuet geubri rincian, lagèe wareuna ngôn susonan lhèe dimensi.
hypothesis: Nyo hana hanya meupeukukuhkan bahwa seucara minimal na padum boh dinosaurus na bulu, teori yang sudah tersebar luas, tetapi meujok detail yang umumnya hana jeut di fosil, lage warna dan susunan tiga dimensi.

source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
reference: Awak ilmuwan kheun bulèe hewan nyoe meuwareuna coklat kastanye bak bagian ateueh ngôn bagian yup meuwareuna pucat atawa meuwareuna karotenoid.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan peugah bulu binatang nyoe ka coklat keutaja di ateueh ngon bagian bawah nyang pucat atawa carotenoid.

source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
reference: Penemuan nyoe bri cit euleumèe teuntang evolusi bulèe bak cicém.
hypothesis: Temuan nyo pih geu bri waham tentang evolusi bulu bak cicém.

source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
reference: Kareuna bulèe dinosaurus hana meubak nyang meukeumang ngôn get, nyang geuseubôt rachis, teutapi na ciri-ciri bulèe laenjih — duroë ngôn barbul — awak peneliti geucok ikhtisar bahwa rachis mungken nakeuh perkembangan evolusi leubéh hayeu dari ciri-ciri laen nyoe.
hypothesis: Kareuna bulu dinosaurus hana na sumbu nyang ka dipeuget, yang dikhen rachis, tapi na fitur-fitur laen dari bulu  barbs dan barbules  para peneliti menyimpulkan rachis mungken merupakan perkembangan evolusioner yeng lheuh nyan fitur-fitur laen nyoe.

source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
reference: Struktur bulèe geupeutunyok bahwa bulèe hana geungui watèe teureubang teutapih keu ato hawa atawa piasan. Awak peneliti geupeugah bahwa, bahpih nyoe nakeuh iku dinosaurus muda, sampel geupeutunyok bulèe dewasa ngôn kon aneuek manoek.
hypothesis: Struktur bulu nyan geu sugesti bahwa awak nyan hana dipakek bak meupeungendong, tapi keu peuregulasi suhu atawa peuleumah.

source: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
reference: Awak peneliti geupeunapat bahwa, bahpih nyoe nakeuh iku dinosaurus muda, sampel meupeutunyok bulèe dewasa ngôn kon aneuek manoek.
hypothesis: Para peneliti geu usul bahwa, meskipun nyoe adalah ek dinosaurus muda, sampel nyan na peunyaket dewasa dan kon aneuk ayam.

source: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
reference: Bom moto nyang beureutoih di markas pulisi di Gaziantep, Turki baroe beungoh nyang geupeumate dua petugas pulisi ngôn geupeucidra leubéh dari dua ploh ureuëng laenjih.
hypothesis: Peuneugöt bom mobil nyang ji detonasi bak markas polisi di Gaziantep, Turki uroe seukari mate dua droe polisi ngen luka le dua ploh droe teuk.

source: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
reference: Kanto gubernur kheun sikureuëng blah dari nyang cidra nakeuh awak pulisi.
hypothesis: Pejabat gubernur geupeugah 19 dari nyang luka nyan nakeuh polisi.

source: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
reference: Pulisi kheun awak nyan curiga ureuëng militan Daesh (ISIL) nyang meutanggong jaweueb ataeuh seureubu nyan.
hypothesis: Polisi geupeugah awak nyan meungadu sidroe militan Daesh (ISIL) yang diduga bertanggung jawab atas serangan nyan.

source: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
reference: Awaknyan geupeuteumèe Matauroe na ateuh ngôn prinsip asai nyang saban lagèe bintang laenjih: Aktivitas bandum bintang lam sistem geuteumèe geugeudra lé luminositasjih, rotasijih, ngôn hana nyang laen.
hypothesis: Awak nyan meurumpok Matahari beroperasi bak prinsip dasar yeng sama lagee bintang laen: Aktivitas mandum bintang dalam sistem nyan diteumee dipakek oleh cahaya, putaran, dan hana laen.

source: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
reference: Luminositas ngôn rotasi geupakek sigoe keu geupeuteuntèe numboi bintang Rossby, nyang meuhubong ngôn aliran plasma.
hypothesis: Luminositas ngen rotasi dipakek seurta untuk geupeuteuntée bilangan Rossby bintang, yeng na hubongan ngen aliran plasma.

source: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
reference: Semakén ubit numboi Rossby, semakén kureuëng aktif bintang nyan keu pembalikan magnet.
hypothesis: Semakin ubit bilangan Rossby, leubeh bacut aktif bintang nyan sehubungan deungen reversasi magnetik.

source: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
reference: Lam perjalananjih, Iwasaki keunong masalah dalam le watèe.
hypothesis: Seulama perjalanan jih, Iwasaki meupeutron masalah bak padum boh kesempatan.

source: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
reference: Gobnyan geucue lé bajak laot, geuseureubu di Tibet lé ase pungo, plung dari meukawen di Nepal ngôn geudrop di India.
hypothesis: Jih dirampok lé bajée balek, diserang di Tibet lé asée nyang na rasa marah, jipeuplueng droe nibak peurawan di Nepal dan jidrob di India.

source: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
reference: Standar 802,11n meuoperasi bak frekuensi 2,4Ghz ngôn 5,0Ghz.
hypothesis: Standar 802.11n beroperasi bak frekuensi 2,4 GHz ngen 5,0 GHz.

source: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
reference: Nyoe akan geupeumungken atranyan keu kompatibel ngôn 802,11a, 802,11b, ngôn 802,11g, asai stasiun pangkalan na radio ganda.
hypothesis: Nyoe akan memungkinkan jih jeut keu backwards kompatibel ngon 802.11a, 802.11b dan 802.11g, seucara syarat stasiun dasar na radio ganda.

source: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
reference: Duvall, nyang kawen ngôn dua aneuek dewasa, hana bri kesan nyang rayek bak Miller, keu soe cerita nyan teukaet.
hypothesis: Duvall, nyang ka meukawen ngon dua droe aneuk nyang ka rayeuk, hana meupeutumee that nibak Miller, nyang ka geucalitra kisah nyan.

source: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
reference: Watèe dilakee komentar, Miller kheun, "Mike le peugah haba lam watèe sidang...Lôn teungoh meukeumaih jadi lôn hana that deungö peu nyang geukheuen."
hypothesis: Watée diminta untuk komentar, Miller peugah, "Mike meututoe that bak sesi sidang...Ulôn teungoh peusiab jadi hana lôn deungoe peue nyang geupeugah".

source: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
reference: "Kamöe meuusaha peukureuëng emisi karbon dioksida per unit PDB ngôn margin peunténg bak thôn 2020 nibak tingkat 2005," jikheun lé Hu.
hypothesis: "Kita akan berusaha untuk meukurangi emisi karbon dioksida per unit PDB deungen marjin nyang nyata deungen 2020 dari tingkat 2005", kata Hu.

source: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
reference: Jih hana jipeuteutap numboi keu ikohjih, geukheun ikohjih nyan geu neuk peugot meunurot output ekonomi China.
hypothesis: Jih hana geu peuteuntée angka untuk pengurangan, kheun jih akan geupeuget berdasarkan output ekonomi China.

source: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
reference: Hu geudra nanggroe-nanggroe nyang ka maju"peujeuoh jalan nyang ka treb nyang geupeukuto terleubéh dilee ngôn geupeugleh euntreuk."
hypothesis: Hu geu dorong negara-negara berkembang "untuk jihindari jalan awai nyang meucemar phon-phon dan ji peugleh leubeh awai".

hypothesis: Lam watee sa thon, sidroe ureung nyang ka keunong infeksi jeut ji peu infeksi 10 sampoe 15 kontak teukeut.

source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
reference: Teutapi, peurséntase XDR-TB bak bandum kawom nyang keunöng tuberkulosis deuhjih mantöng ubeut; 6.000 nibak mandum 330.000 ureuëng teuinfeksi bak meujan-jan watée i Afrika Seulatan.
hypothesis: Namun, persentase XDR-TB di mandum kelompok ureung nyang na tuberkulosis mantong deuh jih bacut; 6.000 dari total 330.000 ureung nyang terinfeksi bak saboh saat tertentu di Afrika Selatan.

source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
reference: Satelit, nyang ban dua na brat leubeh dari 1.000 pon, ngon meugrak lam kecepatan silingka 17.500 mil per jeum, teupok 491 mil di ateueh Bumoe.
hypothesis: Satelit-satelit nyan, yang dua jih beurat jih leubeh dari 1.000 pon, dan berela rot sekitar 17.500 mil per jam, tabrak 491 mil di ateueh bumoe.

source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
reference: Ureueng meueleumee geukheun beureutoh nyan nyang teujadi sabab meupok nyan nakeuh beureutoh nyang raya that.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan peugah ledakan nyang disebabkan le tabrakan nyan rayeuk.

source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
reference: Awak nyan mantong geucuba geupeuteuntee ubena rayek meupok nyan ngon kiban Bumoe akan teupeungaba.
hypothesis: Awaknyan mantong ji coba untuk teuteupek padubna rayeuk jih kecelakaan nyan dan pakriban bumoe akan keunong.

source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
reference: Komando Strategis Amerika Serikat dari kanto Departemen Pertahanan AS teungoh geumita puing-puing nyan.
hypothesis: Komando Strategis Amerika Serikat dari Kantor Departemen Pertahanan Amerika Serikat teungoh geulacak pucok-pucok.

source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
reference: Hase analisis plot akan geuposting bak situs publik.
hypothesis: Hasil analisis plot akan diposting bak saboh website umum.

source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
reference: Dotöer nyang keureuja bak Children's Hospital Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania geuneukdakwa deungôn brat ateuh haigeupoh ureuëng ‘oh lheuh mak göbnyan geuteumée ka matèe lam bagasi moto göbnyan Rabu, pihak nyang mat kuwasa i Ohio kheun.
hypothesis: Dokter nyang peuget kerja di Rumah Sakit Keutamaan Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania akan dituduh meurampok parah lheuh mak jih teutap mate bak bak bak treuk mobil jih uroe Rabu, pihak berwenang di Ohio peugah.

source: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
reference: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, geuteumée di Blue Ash, Ohio, binéh kuta lingka 15 mil siblah utara Cincinnati nyang teuèh bak tanöh i binéh rauh deungôn bajée kawoh oblong ngôn bajée idalam lam keuadaan meuubat nyang deuhjih brat.
hypothesis: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29 thon, teutap di Blue Ash, Ohio, saboh pinggiran sekitar 15 mil utara Cincinnati teuduek di darat di seukeulileng jalan lam kaos dan pakaian dalam dalam dalam keadaan yang deuh jih sangat meubat.

source: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
reference: Göbnyan geupeuho peutugas u Oldsmoto Intrik itam göbnyan nyang jiôh trôh u 500 gaki.
hypothesis: Jih laju jiurôh peugawée u Intrigue Oldsmobile nyang itam jih nyang na 500 metée jiôh.

source: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
reference: Hinan, awak nyan geuteumée tubôh Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, nyang geutôp ngön ija limbôt nyang peunoh ngön darah.
hypothesis: Disinan, awak nyan meurumpok awak awak Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, nyang teukeupong deungon mantel nyang meuceh darah.

source: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
reference: Pulisi geukheun bahwa ma‘nyéet nyan deuhjih kana hinan meu siuröe.
hypothesis: Polisi geupeugah bahwa bangke nyan deuh jih na disinan kira-kira seumeun uroe.

source: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
reference: Peukara phôn nibak peunyakét musém nyoe geubrithéei bak akhèe Juli.
hypothesis: Kasus awai peunyakét musim nyoe ka ji lapor bak akhe Juli.

source: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
reference: Peunyakét nyoe iba lé bui, nyang lheuh nyan ipinah bak manusiya röt jamök.
hypothesis: Peunyakét nyan di peugeut le bui, yang kemudian meugeut bak manusia melalui nyamuk.

source: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
reference: Tae‘eun nyôe ka geuyue lè pömeurèntah India keu geupebuet peunceugahan lagée geupeusipreuk keu drop bui i daerah nyang ka keunöng brat, distribusi meuribée tirai jamök ngôn geuseumpröe pestisida.
hypothesis: Peunyakét nyan ka geu pimpén pemerintah India keu geu angkat langkah-langkah lagee peungikot penangkapan babi di daerah nyang ka keunong parah, geu peubloe meuribée-ribée langet nyamuk dan geu seram peucamatan.

source: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
reference: Ladôm juta plok vaksin ensefalitis ka geujanji cit lé pöemeurèntah, nyang geuneuk tulông lam peusaneut leumbaga keusihatan keu thôn ukeu.
hypothesis: Padum juta botol vaksin encefalitis cit ka dijanjiké lé pemerintah, nyang akan membantu peusiab agensi kesehatan untuk thon ukeu.

source: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
reference: Reuncana kirèm vaksin u daèrah-daèrah nyang palèng meupeungarôh ngôn historis thôn nyôe geupeutheun sabab kureuëng dana ngôn prioritas nyang ubeut nibak peunyakèt laèn.
hypothesis: Rencana untuk vaksin untuk di peujok u wilayah nyang paleng keunong seujarah thon nyoe ka teutarek kareuna hana dana dan prioritas yeng bacut seucara teutapkan keu peunyakét-peunyakét la'én.

source: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
reference: Bak thôn 1956 Słania pinah u Swedia, di pat lhèe thôn alheuh nyan gobnyan phôn keurija keu Kantô Pos Swedia ngôn jeut keu awak ukée keupala awaknyan.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1956 Słania pindah u Swedia, lhee thon lheuh nyan gobnyan mulai bekerja bak Kantor Pos Swedia dan jeut keu kepala ukiran jih.

source: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
reference: Göbnyan geupeuhasé leubèh dari 1.000 prangkô keu Swedia ngôn 28 nanggröe laénjih.
hypothesis: Jih jipeuget le 1.000 prangko untuk Swedia ngen 28 negara laen.

source: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
reference: Karya göbnyan na teureuta ngôn detail nyang geu peugah beutôi ‘oh trôh nakeuh salah saböh dari bacut "nyang geuturi lé ramé ureuëng" di antara awak filatelis. Ladôm geupeukhusôih lam geupeukumpôi karyagobnyan keudröe.
hypothesis: Karya jih nyan na kualitas dan detail nyang that jiaku sampoe jih na di antara "ngaran rumah tangga" nyang bacut lamkawan philatelists.

source: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
reference: Stempèl göbnyan nyang keu 1000 nakeuh "Buet Rayéuk Raja Swedia" nyang luar biasa le David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl bak thôn 2000, nyang meujadôi lam Guinness Book of World Records.
hypothesis: Stempel jih nyang keu 1.000 nakeuh "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" nyang geupeuget lé David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl bak thon 2000, nyang na di daftar di Guinness Book of World Records.

source: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
reference: Göbnyan meulibat lam geupeucuréh pèng keureutaih keu le nanggröe, contoh nyang paléng barô dari karya göbnyan teumasôk potret Peurdana Meuntröe di bagian keuë pèng keureutaih Kanada $5 ngön $100 nyang barô.
hypothesis: Jih pih ji peuget ukiran banknotes keu le nanggroe, contoh-contoh baro dari karya jih termasuk retret Perdana Menteri di bagian muka banknotes $5 dan $100 Kanada baro.

source: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
reference: Oh lheuh ceulaka nyan teujadi, Gibson geuba u rumôh sakét teutapi meninggai hana tréb alheuh nyan.
hypothesis: Lheuh kecelakaan nyan terjadi, Gibson di angkot u rumah sakit tapi meuninggai hana treb le lheuh nyan.

source: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
reference: Ureuëng nyang ba truk, nyang meu‘umu 64 thôn, hana cidra dalam ceulaka nyan.
hypothesis: Supir treuk, yang umu 64 thon, hana luka bak musibah nyan.

source: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
reference: Keundaraan nyan geuba dari lokasi keuceulakaan lingka pöh 12.00 GMT bak uröe nyang saban.
hypothesis: Kendaraan nyan keudroe dijak dari tempat kecelakaan kira-kira 1200 GMT bak uroe nyan cit.

source: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
reference: Ureuëng nyang keurija lam garasi rap teumpat ceulaka kheun: "Na aneu'-aneu' nyang muprèh keu jak köeh ra'ueh ngôn awak nyan bandum klik ngôn môe."
hypothesis: Sidroe ureuëng nyang keureuja bak saboh garasi di teumpat peunyakét nyan teujadi geupeugah, "Na aneuk miet teungoh preh-preh keu jijak jeumeurang rot dan awaknyan mandum jikuk-kuk dan jimoe".

source: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
reference: Awak nyan bandum meupluëng meugisa dari teumpat nyang disinan keujadian ceulaka nyan.
hypothesis: Awaknyan mandum jiplueng bak teumpat musibah nyan ka teujadi.

source: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
reference: Topik laén dalam agènda di Bali teumasôk geupeuseulamat uteuën nyang meusisa di dônya, ngôn meubagi teknologi keu geubantu nanggröe meukeumang keu timôh deungôn cara nyang hana geupeuhasée polusi.
hypothesis: Subyek laen di agenda di Bali termasuk peuseulamat hutan nyang na di donya, dan berbagi teknologi untuk membantu negara berkembang berkembang bak cara yang kurang polusi.

source: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
reference: PBB meuharap cit keu geupeuseuleusöe dana keu geupeubantu nanggröe-nanggröe nyang meukeunông dampak pemanasan global keu geuatasi dampak nyan.
hypothesis: PBB juga berharap untuk geupeusapat dana untuk membantu negara-negara nyang keunong seu-uem global untuk meu-hadap dampak jih.

source: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
reference: Pèng nyan jeut geupakèk keu rumoh theun ië raya, pengelolaan ië nyang leubèh gèt, ngôn diversifikasi tanaman.
hypothesis: Uroenyan jeut keu rumoh nyang hana keunong banjir, pengelolaan air nyang leubeh get, dan peubah panen.

source: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
reference: Fluke tuléh bahwa ladôm useuha nyang geupubuët lé ladom ureuëng keu geupeu'iem awak inông mangat hana meututôe teuntang keusehatan awak inông hana hasée.
hypothesis: Fluke teunuléh bahwa upaya le padum-padum ureuëng inong untuk meucaruet hana meupeugah tentang kesehatan inong hana meuhase.

source: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
reference: Göbnyan sampöe bak keusimpulan nyôe keureuna le komentar positif ngôn geu peukrue seumangat nyang geukirém keu göbnyan le individu inông ngôn agam nyang meurasa peureulèe ubat kontrasepsi keupeujeut seubagöe kebutuhan medis.
hypothesis: Jih meuhase keu peundirian nyoe kareuna le comment positif dan dorongan nyang dirujuk keu jih le ureung inong ngen ureung agam nyang meulakée bahwa ubat kontrasepsi dianggap keu keperluan medis.

source: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
reference: Watèe prang ka jipiyôh ‘oh lheuh nyang cidra geuba u rumôh sakét, lingka 40 narapidana nyang tinggai jidue' lam taman ngôn tulak keu riwang u sèl awaknyan.
hypothesis: Watée prang nyan teupiôh lheuh awak nyang luka nyan jiba u rumah sakit, kira-kira 40 tahanan nyang laén tinggai di halaman dan hana jitem woe u sel-sel droe.

source: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
reference: Negosiator cuba peugét situasi, teutapi tuntutan awak tahanan hana jelaih.
hypothesis: Peurunding geucuba geuboh peukara nyan, teuma tuntutan tahanan nyan hana jelas.

source: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
reference: Antara 22.00-23.00 MDT, apui kageutôt lé narapidana di halaman.
hypothesis: Antara 10:00-11:00 malam MDT, apui dipeuphon le tahanan di halaman.

source: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
reference: Hana trép alheueh nyan, petugas deungön perlengkapan anti huru hara tamöng u halaman ngôn geupeusagöe narapidana nyan deungön gah ië mata.
hypothesis: Hana treb le, peuwira nyang na peungawai nyang meupeungawai keukayaan jitamong u dalam peulataran dan jipeutamong ureuëng-ureuëng tahanan nyan lam saboh jurong ngon gas mata.

source: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
reference: Petugas pemadam apui akhéejih jeut geupeuléen apui bak pöh 23.35.
hypothesis: Awak penyelamat peunyakét akhe jih jipeuphon peumaté apui nyan bak poh 11.35 malam.

source: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
reference: ‘Oh lheuh bendungan geupeudöng bak thôn 1963, ië raya tiëp musém nyang akan geupeuhayak sedimen u bandum kruëng ka piyôh.
hypothesis: Lheuh bendungan nyan dipeugot bak thon 1963, banjir musiman yang akan meutabu sedimen di lhok krueng nyan dipeuganto.

source: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
reference: Sedimen nyoe geupeureulèe keu peugöt bukét anoe ubeut ngön panté, nyang meuguna sebagöe habitat satwa kleuët.
hypothesis: Sediemen nyoe diperlukan untuk peuget bar pasir ngen pantai, yeng jeut keu habitat satwa liar.

source: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
reference: Akibatjih, dua spesies eungkôt ka punah, ngôn dua laénjih teuayeuë leunyab, teumasôk humpback chub.
hypothesis: Akibat jih, dua spesies ikan ka punah, dan dua spesies laen ka jeut keu ancaman, termasuk bumbback chub.

source: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
reference: Bahpih manyang ië jeut i ék meupadum metèe sagai ‘oh lheuh ië raya, awak pejabat meuharap nyan akan sép keu geupeuriwang löm bukét anôe ubét nyang meuerosi bak kuwala.
hypothesis: Meskipun tingkat ie akan jitingkat hanya padum metir lheuh banjir, pejabat berharap akan cukup untuk meupeuglehkan bar pasir yang terurai di darat.

source: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
reference: Hana peringatan tsunami nyang geupeutubiët, ngôn meunurôt badan geofisika Jakarta, hana peringatan tsunami nyang akan geupeutubiët keureuna gempa nyan hana geupeunôh persyaratan magnitudo 6,5.
hypothesis: Hana peringatan tsunami nyang ka geupeuteubiet, dan menurut agensi geofisika Jakarta, hana peringatan tsunami nyang akan geupeuteubiet kareuna geumpa bumoe nyan hana memenuhi syarat magnitudo 6.5.

source: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
reference: Adakpih hana ancaman tsunami, masyarakat ka mulai takôt ngôn mulai geupeutinggai teumpat usaha ngôn rumôh awaknyan.
hypothesis: Meskipun hana ancaman tsunami, penduduk mulai panik dan mulai geutinggai bisnis dan rumoh jih.

source: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
reference: Bahpih Winfrey môe lam perpisahan göbnyan, ureuëngnyan geupeujeulaih keu penggemar göbnyan bahwa göbnyan akan geuriwang.
hypothesis: Meskipun Winfrey seudeh bak seudeukah jih, jih bri jelas keu penggemar jih bahwa jih akan jiwoe.

source: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
reference: "Nyôe kön perpisahan. Nyôe nakeuh penutupan saböh bab ngôn pembukaan saböh bab nyang barô."
hypothesis: "Nyoe hana akan seujahteura. Nyoe adalah penutupan saboh bab dan pembukaan saboh bab barô".

source: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
reference: Wasée akhée nibak peumiléh presiden ngôn parleumén Namibia geupeutunyôk bahwa presiden peutahanan, Hifikepunye Pohamba, ka geupiléh lôm deungôn seuliséh nyang rayéuk.
hypothesis: Hasil akhir dari pilkada presiden dan parlemen Namibia ka geu peutunyok bahwa presiden nyang teungoh meutugaih, Hifikepunye Pohamba, ka teupiléh lom deungen gareh nyang raya.

source: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
reference: Peurtéi nyang mat kuwasa, Organisasi Rakyat Afrika Barat Daya (SWAPO), geupeutheun cit mayoritas lam peumiléh parleumén.
hypothesis: Parté nyang na bak teumpat peumeurintah, Organisasi Rakyat Afrika Barat Daya (SWAPO), pih na meurdéhakan bak peumbah parlemen.

source: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
reference: Koalisi ngön kapilah Afghanistan minah u dairah nyan keu geupeuaman teumpat ngön kapai teureubang koalisi laénjih ka geukirém keu meutulông.
hypothesis: Koalisi ngen pasukan Afghanistan geujak u wilayah nyan keu geujaga situs nyan dan pesawat koalisi laen ka geu kirém keu geu bantu.

source: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
reference: Musibah nyan meudali dum bak dairah meugunông, ngôn geuyakin sebagöe musabab nibak timbak musôh.
hypothesis: Kabrak nyan terjadi di daerah gunong, dan diyakini seubab jih akibat dari api musoh.

source: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
reference: Upaya keu mita teumpat musibah peunôh deungôn cuwaca brôk ngôn dairah prang nyang kreuëh.
hypothesis: Usah-usah untuk mita teumpat musibah nyan ka dipeuprang le cuaca nyang brok ngen medan nyang brat.

source: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
reference: Badan amal medis Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres ngôn Organisasi Keusihatan Dônya kheun nyan nakeuh ta‘eun paléng brôk nyang meutuléh nanggröe nyôe.
hypothesis: Aksi amal medis Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontières ngen Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia peugah jih nakeuh wabah terburuk nyang ka ji catet di nanggroe nyan.

source: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
reference: Juru Bicara Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman kheun: "Angola teungôh ipeukeu ta‘eun paléng brôk ngôn keuadaan teutap paléng brôk i Angola," geukheun lé jih.
hypothesis: Juru bicara Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman geupeugah: "Angola teungoh ji maju u lahe jih nyang paleng parah dan situasi mantong that parah di Angola", kheun jih.

source: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
reference: Meuneu'en dimulai poh 10:00 beungoh ngon cuaca nyang get bah that ujeun meupreut-preut bak beungoh nyang pirang deungon bagah, nyan adalah uroe nyang samporeuna untuk rugby 7.
hypothesis: Seulaén ujeuen beungoh nyang ka awai, uroe nyan uroe nyang paleng cocok keu rugby 7 uroe.

source: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
reference: Unggulan paleng ateueh turnamen Afrika Selatan geumulai ngon catatan nyang meuyakinkan watee awak nyan meunang mangat 26 - 00 meulawan unggulan ke-5 Zambia .
hypothesis: Seulaen seunang turnamen Afrika Selatan mulai di catatan yang teupat wate awak nyan na kemenangan yang nyaman 26 - 00 terhadap seunang ke-5 Zambia.

source: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
reference: Deuh peungeuh brok dalam permainan meulawan syedara inong seulatan awak nyan, tapi Afrika Selatan laju diek watee turnamen meulangsong.
hypothesis: Meulaboh that karat lam game lawan adoe-aduen jih di seulatan, Afrika Selatan namun secara konsisten meucen seiring turnamen nyan maju.

source: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
reference: Pertahanan disiplin awak nyan, keterampilan geume bola, ngon keurija tim nyang hayeu meupeuget awak nyan menonjol, jeulah bahwa nyoe keuh tim nyang haroh dipeutalo.
hypothesis: Pertahanan jih nyang disiplin, keterampilan pengendalian bola dan kerja tim yang sangat baik membuat jih menonjol dan jelas bahwa nyoe adalah tim yang harus dikalahkan.

source: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
reference: Peujabat kuta Amsterdam ngôn Museum Anne Frank kheun bahwa bak nyan ka meukulat ngôn meupeuseubab bahaya keusihatan ureuëng ramée sabab awaknyan ipeugah bahwa bak nyan lam bahya reubah.
hypothesis: Peumbantu kota Amsterdam ngen Museum Anne Frank geu kheun bahwa bak nyan ka keunong jamur dan jeut keu bahaya kesehatan masyarakat karena awaknyan meupeugah bahwa bak nyan na bahaya that-that jikalam jih reubah.

source: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
reference: Nyan ka geujadwal keu geuteubang bak uröe Seulasa, teutapih geupeuseulamat ‘oh lheuh keuputusan peungadilan darurat.
hypothesis: Peuristiwa nyan ka dijadwalkan keu dipeugadôh bak uroe Selasa, teuma dipeuseulamat lheuh keputusan pengadilan darurat.

source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.

source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.

source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.

source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
reference: Sigohlom pasokan troh, Haiti hana keunong masalah sapeue nyang teukaet ngon peunyaket nyan dari thon 1800-an.
hypothesis: Sigohlom teuka pasukan, Haiti hana meurumpok masalah yeng meuhubongan ngen peunyakét nyan seujak thon 1800-an.

source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.

source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.

source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.

reference: Ureueng sakét tom u Nigeria, teumpat ladom peukara virus Ebola ka meudali.
hypothesis: Pasien nyan ka na di Nigeria, di sinan na padum-padum kasus virus Ebola.

source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
reference: Rumoh sakét ka ipateh protokol peungeundalian infeksi, teumasok geupeuaséng ureueng sakét nibak ureueng laén keu geuhindar keumungkénan infeksi ureueng laén.
hypothesis: Rumah sakit ka ji ikot protokol untuk kontrol infeksi, termasuk membedakan pasien dari ureung laen untuk mencegah infeksi yang mungken dari ureung laen.

source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
reference: Sigohlom The Simpsons Simon ka keurija i ladom piasan bak macam posisi.
hypothesis: Sigohlom The Simpsons Simon ka geubantu bak padum-padum acara lam padum-padum jabatan.

source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
reference: Seulama thôn 1980-an gobnyan keurija bak acara-acara lagèe Taxi, Cheers, ngön The Tracy Ullman Show.
hypothesis: Seulama thon 1980-an jih geu keureuja bak acara lage Taxi, Cheers, dan The Tracy Ullman Show.

source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
reference: Bak thôn 1989 gobnyan geutulông geupeugöt The Simpsons seureuta Brooks ngön Groening, ngön meutanggong jaweueb ateuh geupeukeurija tim teumuleh phôn piasan nyan.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1989 jih geu bantu untuk geu peuget The Simpsons meusapat ngon Brooks dan Groening, dan geu tanggung jawab untuk geu peugöt tim penulisan pertamanya.

source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
reference: Bahpih geupeutinggai piasan bak thôn 1993 gobnyan geupeutheun geular produser eksekutif, ngön mantöng teurimoeng meuplôh juta dolar tiep musem lam beuntuk royalti.
hypothesis: Meskipun geutinggai acara nyan bak thon 1993 jih geujaga gelar produser eksekutif, dan terus geuteurimong meurapoh juta dolar setiap musim sebagai royalti.

source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
reference: Sigohlomjiih kanto haba China Xinhua geubrithèe saboh kapai teureubang geubajak.
hypothesis: Phon awai ilée agensi berita Cina Xinhua ka ji lapor saboh pesawat akan ji culik.

source: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
reference: Laporan dudoe kheun kapai teureubang teurimoeng ancaman bom ngön geualeh pulang u Afghanistan, geupeudarat i Kandahar.
hypothesis: Laporan yeng lheuh nyan geu kheun pesawat nyan geuteurimong ancaman bom dan geu ubah lom u Afghanistan, di darat di Kandahar.

source: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
reference: Laporan awai kheun kapai teureubang nyan geualeh pulang u Afghanistan lheuh geutulak geupeudarat darurat di Ürümqi.
hypothesis: Laporan awai geu kheun pesawat nyan ka ji ubah u Afghanistan lheuh hana geupeutamong darurat di Ürümqi.

source: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
reference: Keuceulakaan udara kayem teujadi i Iran, nyang na armada tuha nyang hana geujaga deungön gèt keu opeurasi sipil atawapih militer.
hypothesis: Kajeut udara biasa di Iran, yang na armada nyang tuha nyang hana dipeuteun keu operasi sipil ngon militer.

source: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
reference: Hukôman internasional meumakna bahwa kapai teureubang barô hana jeut gatabloe.
hypothesis: Sanksi internasional ka geu arti bahwa pesawat baroe hana jeut di bloe.

source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
reference: Awai peukan nyoe, keuceulakaan helikopter pulisi geupeumaté lhèe ureueng ngön geupeucidra lhèe laénjih.
hypothesis: Awal minggu nyoe, saboh kecelakaan helikopter polisi mate lhee droe dan luka lhee droe teuk.

source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
reference: Buleuen nyang ka leupah Iran keunong bencana udara paléng brôk lam ladom thôn watèe saboh kapai teureubang menuju Armenia rhôt, geupeumaté 168 ureueng di dalamjih.
hypothesis: Buleuen nyang ka lheueh Iran na musibah udara nyang paleng parah lam padum thon wate saboh pesawat peurahô nyang teungoh jak u Armenia ka rhot, dan 168 droe awak nyan meuninggai donya.

source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
reference: Bak buleuen nyan sit, kapai teureubang laén geupeusrang landasan pacu di Mashhad ngön geupeupôk binteh, geupeutiwah tujôh blaih ureueng.
hypothesis: Buleuen nyan cit cit deuh neukalon saboh pesawat laen ji-jeumeurang saboh landasan di Mashhad dan ji-jeumeurang saboh beuton, nyang na 17 droe meuninggai donya.

source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
reference: Aerosmith ka geupeubateue euncit konser awak nyan lam tur awak nyan.
hypothesis: Aerosmith ka geupeubateue konser nyang na di tourne jih.

source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
reference: Band rock nyoe geujadoi geupubuet tur u Amèrika Suerikat ngön Kanada sampoe 16 September.
hypothesis: Band rock nyan akan touring Amerika Serikat ngen Kanada sampoe 16 September.

source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
reference: Awak nyan ka geupeubateue tur lheuh penyanyi utama Steven Tyler meulut lheuh gobnyan rhot dari panggong watèe leumah bak 5 Agustus.
hypothesis: Awak nyan ka geupeubateue tur nyan lheuh penyanyi utama Steven Tyler luka lheuh jih rhot dari penteng seulama tampil bak 5 Agustus.

source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
reference: Murray talô lam set phôn lam tie break lheuh banduwa agam nyan geupeutheun tiep servis di set nyan.
hypothesis: Murray kalah set phon bak tie break lheuh mandua droe ureung nyan dipeuget saban serve dalam set.

source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
reference: Del Potro na keunggulan awai di set kedua, tapi nyoe sit peureulèe tie break lheuh trôh bak 6-6.
hypothesis: Del Potro na keuntungan awai di set keudua, tapi nyoe cit membutuhkan istirahat tie setelah mencapai 6-6.

source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
reference: Potro teurimong perawatan di baho gobnyan jinoe tapi meuhasé balek u permeuenan.
hypothesis: Potro geuteurimong perawatan bak bahu jih bak titik nyoe tetapi meuhase geuwoe bak permainan.

source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
reference: Program geumulai bak poh 20.30 malam. Watèe di sinan (15.00 UTC).
hypothesis: Program nyan dimulai bak jam 8:30 malam watee lokal (15.00 UTC).

source: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
reference: Penyanyi meuceuhu di bandum nanggroe geupeuleumah bhajan, atawa lagu renungan, di gaki Shri Shyam.
hypothesis: Penyanyi terkenal di nanggroe seulama nyan geupeujok bhajans, atawa lagu-lagu deungön, bak gaki Shri Shyam.

source: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
reference: Penyanyi Sanju Sharma geupeumulai malam nyan, geuikot lé Jai Shankar Choudhary. Lanjot chhappan bhog bhajan sit. Penyanyi, Raju Khandelwal peuteumon gobnyan.
hypothesis: Penyanyi Sanju Sharma mulai malam nyan, diikuti le Jai Shankar Choudhary. geu esentasi chhappan bhog bhajan cit. Penyanyi, Raju Khandelwal geumiréngkan gobnyan.

source: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
reference: Dudoe, Lakkha Singh geupimpen lam meunyanyi bhajan.
hypothesis: Lheueh nyan, Lakkha Singh geupimpén dalam meuca-e bhajans.

source: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
reference: 108 pingan Chhappan Bhog (lam agama Hindu, 56 dabeuh bida nyang jeut geupajoh, lagèe, bombom, boh kayèe, kacang, hidangan, dll. nyang geuseumbah keu dewa) geuidang keu Baba Shyam.
hypothesis: 108 piring Chhappan Bhog (dalam agama Hindu, 56 macam makanan, lage, permen, buah, kacang, piring dll nyang di peuseumah keu dewa) dihidangkan keu Baba Shyam.

source: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
reference: Lakkha Singh geupeuseumbah chhappan bhog bhajan sit. Peunyanyi, Raju Khandelwal peuteumon gobnyan.
hypothesis: Lakkha Singh geupeujok cit bhajan chhappan bhog.

source: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
reference: Bak presentasi utama Tokyo Game Show uroe hameh, presiden Nintendo Satoru Iwata geupeuteubiet desainkontrol keu konsol Nintendo Revolution barô ata perusahaan.
hypothesis: Bak presentasi utama Tokyo Game Show uroe Khamis, presiden Nintendo Satoru Iwata geupeuleumah desain controller untuk konsol Nintendo Revolution baroe perusahaan nyan.

source: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
reference: Meuhi deungön remote televisi, kontrol jingui duwa boih sensor nyang geuduek di toe televisi ureueng ngui keu geupeusipat posisijih lam ruweueng lhèe dimensi.
hypothesis: Meucameh ngon remote televisi, controller meupakek dua sensor yang dipeuduek di seukeulileng televisi pengguna untuk geu triangula posisi jih di ruang tiga dimensi.

source: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
reference: Nyoe akan geupeumungkén pemeuen geupeutimang tindakan ngön grak lam video game deungön geupeugrak peurangkat di udara.
hypothesis: Nyo akan dipeugisa pemain untuk mengendalikan tindakan ngen gerakan lam game video deungon meupeugadoh perangkat melalui udara.

source: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
reference: Giancarlo Fisichella gadoh kendali ateuh motojih ngön geupeuakhe balapan bagah lheuh geupeuphôn.
hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella kehilangan kontrol mobil jih dan geupeuseuleusoe bala peulataran nyan sigra lheuh awai.

source: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
reference: Rakan saboh timjih Fernando Alonso geupeuhue ladom balapan, tapi geupeuakhe nyan teupat lheuh pit-stop, mungkén sabab ruda keu uneun meususop deungön brok.
hypothesis: Seureuta tim jih Fernando Alonso na di pimpénan untuk sebagian rayek balapan, tapi geupeuseuleusoe nyan seureuta lheuh pit-stop jih, mungken karena roda depan kanan yang salah tertusuk.

source: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
reference: Michael Schumacher geupeuakhe balapanjih hana treb lheuh Alonso, sabab kerusakan suspensi lam lë bagoe pertempuran lawét balapan.
hypothesis: Michael Schumacher geupeusapat balapan jih hana treb lheuh Alonso, kareuna rusak suspensi bak padum boh geumpa seulama balapan.

source: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
reference: "Gobnyan that gleuen ngön meunyanyi deungön that gèt sit," geukhen lé gobnyan meunurot transkrip konferensi pers.
hypothesis: "Jih nyan sangat lucu dan nyanyi lagak, cit", kheun jih meunurot transkripsi konferensi pers.

source: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
reference: Lon weueh tiep gö kamoe peubuet latihan nyoe, beutoi-beutoi dari lam ate lôn.
hypothesis: "Ulôn get that get tieb-tieb watee kamoe peuget percobaan tentang nyoe, dari dalam hati".

source: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
reference: Silingka 3 meunét lheuh peluncuran, kamera meupasang meupeutunyok lë bahagian kuboh insulasi teulheueh dari tangki bahan bakar.
hypothesis: Kira-kira 3 menit lheuh peluncuran, saboh kamera di dalam teulakee le that-that beuton busa isolasi dipeubeukah dari bak bahan bakar.

source: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
reference: Tapi, awak nyan hana sangka ka geupeusabab kerusakan bak kapai teureubang ulang-alik.
hypothesis: Namun, awak nyan hana dianggap ka jipeurusak peurahô.

source: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
reference: Cheh program kapai teureubang ulang-alik NASA N. Wayne Haie Jr. geukheuen busa nyan rhot "lheuh watèe nyang kamoe kawate akan nyan."
hypothesis: Kepala program ulang-alik NASA N. Wayne Hale Jr. geupeugah busa nyan ka rhot "meungka watee yang tanyoe gundah".

source: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
reference: Limong meunét lheueh piasan nyan, angèn ka jipot, silingka simeunét dudoe, angèn trôh 70km/jeum... dudoe ujeun tron, tapi that leubat ngön that rayeuk sampoe jeut tampa kulet gata lagèe jarom, dudoe ujeun eh tron dari langet, ureueng-ureueng bingöng ngön meuklik ngön meuplueng sabèe keudroe-droe.
hypothesis: Limong menit lam tampilan angén mulai meugulung, kira-kira seulanjut jih, angén trok 70km/h... laju teuka ujeuen, teuma brat dan raya sampoe ji-geulawa kulit gata lagee jarum, laju ujeuen es rhot dari langet, ureuëng-ureuëng panik dan jerit-jerit dan jiplueng-plueng.

source: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
reference: Lon gadoh syédara inöng lôn ngön rakanjih, ngön lam perjalanan lôn na duwa ureueng cacat di keurusi ruda, ureueng-ureueng grob ngön tula awak nyan," geukheun lé Armand Versace.
hypothesis: Ulôn ka gadôh adoe ngon rakan jih, dan bak rot ulôn na dua droe ureuëng cacat di kursi roda, ureung-ureueng nyang cuma lon lom dan ji teugok awak nyan", Armand Versace geupeugah.

source: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
reference: NHK geupeuthèe sit bahwa pembangkit leseutirik tenaga nuklir Kashiwazaki Kariwa di prefektur Niigata meuoperasi ngön normal.
hypothesis: NHK cit ji lapor bahwa pembangkit listrik nuklir Kashiwazaki Kariwa di prefektur Niigata beroperasi secara normal.

source: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
reference: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. geupeuthèe hana efek dari geumpa ngön bahwa reaktor Nomor 1 ngön 2 bak pembangkit leseutirik tenaga nuklir Shika geutop.
hypothesis: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. dipeugah hana efek dari geumpa bumoe dan bahwa reaktor Nomor 1 dan 2 di pembangkit listrik nuklir jih di Shika ka dipeutamat.

source: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
reference: Geupeuthèe bahwa silingka 9400 rumoh di wilayah nyan hana ie ngön silingka 100 hana leseutirik.
hypothesis: Ka ji lapor bahwa na kira-kira 9.400 rumoh di wilayah nyan hana meu ié dan kira-kira 100 rumoh hana listrik.

source: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
reference: Ladom jalan reuloh, layanan kereta apui teuputoih di daerah nyang keunong akibat, ngön Bandara Noto di prefektur Ishikawa teutap geutop.
hypothesis: Ladom rot ka rusak, layanan kereta api dipeutadoh di daerah nyang keunong, dan Bandara Noto di prefektur Ishikawa tetap ditutup.

source: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
reference: Saboh bom beureutoih di luwa kanto gubernur jenderal.
hypothesis: Sidroe bom meledak di luwa kantor gubernur umum.

source: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
reference: Lhèe bom beureutoih di toe geudong-geudong poemerentah lam watèe duwa jeum.
hypothesis: Lhee bom laen dipeuplah deungen bangunan pemerintah lam periode dua jam.

source: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
reference: Ladom laporan kheun jeumeulah kurubeuen maté resmi bak lapan, ngön laporan resmi geupeuteuntèe bahwa sampoe 30 meulut; tapi angka akhejih gohlom geutupue.
hypothesis: Ladom laporan geu kheun jumlah awak nyang meuninggai nyan na lapan, dan laporan resmi geu konfirmasi bahwa sampoe 30 luka; tapi jumlah final hana teutap meuteume.

source: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
reference: Asam sianurat ngön melamin geuteumèe lam sampel urin hiweuen peliharaan nyang maté lheuh pajoh makanan hiweuen nyang meukontaminasi.
hypothesis: Sidroe asam sianur dan melamin teutap lam sampel urin dari hewan peunindong nyang meuninggai leuh ka lheueh jipajoh makanan hewan peunindong nyang ka kontaminasi.

source: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
reference: Banduwa senyawong nyan meureaksi saboh ngön nyang laén keu geupeugöt kristal nyang jeut geupeulinteueng keureuja ginjal, geukheun lé awak peneliti di universitas nyan.
hypothesis: Dua senyawa nyan bereaksi antara sidroe ngon nyang laen untuk membentuk kristal yang mungken meutanggong fungsi ginjal, kheun para peneliti di universitas nyan.

source: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
reference: Awak peneliti geupeukalon kristal nyang meurupa lam urin miong deungön penambahan melamin ngön asam sianurat.
hypothesis: Para peneliti meukawai kristal nyang dipeuget lam urin kucing leuh melamine ngen asam cianuric.

source: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
reference: Komposisi kristal nyoe meuhie deungön nyang geuteumèe lam urin hiweuen peliharaan nyang keunong meunyô geubandeng deungön spektroskopi inframerah (FTIR).
hypothesis: Komposisi kristal nyo saban ngon yang teumeutume bak urin hewan peunindong yang keunong meunyoe dibandingkan deungen spektroskopi inframerah (FTIR).

source: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
reference: Lôn hana tupue pue gata thèe nyan atawa hana, tapi ladom dabeuh nibak Amèrika Teungoh tamöng u nanggroe nyoe pre biyaya.
hypothesis: Ulôn hana kuteupeue peu kheueh gata ta teupeu atawa hana, teuma leungkeum barang dari Amerika Tengah teuka u nanggroe nyoe hana meubuleh.

source: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
reference: Tapi lapan plôh peursen dabeuh kamoe keunoeng pajak roet tarif i nanggroe-nanggroe Amèrika Teungoh. Kamoe peulaku Gata.
hypothesis: Namun 80 persen barang kamoe ditopoh melalui tarif di nanggroe Amerika Tengah.

source: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
reference: Bahgi lôn nyan hana itamöng lam akai; nyan teuntèe zalem.
hypothesis: Nyan hana seubahasa keu ulôn; nyan pasti hana beuna.

source: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
reference: Nyang lôn kheun keu ureueng-ureueng nakeuh gata peulaku kamoe lagèe kamoe peulaku gata.
hypothesis: Nyang ulôn peugah ubak ureuëng laén na kheueh gata peusaneut kamoe lagée kamoe peusaneut gata.

source: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
reference: Gubeurnur California Arnold Schwarzenegger geuteken hukôm nyang geutham peublo atawa peusiwa video game biadeub keu aneuk ubeut umu.
hypothesis: Gubernur California Arnold Schwarzenegger dipeutanda undang-undang yeng melarang penjualan atawa penyewaan video game ke aneuk miet.

source: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
reference: RUU nyan karab wajeb video game biadeub nyang geupeubloe i nanggroe bahgian California geuboeh cap deungön stiker meutuleh "18" ngön peugöt publoejih u aneuk ubeut umu jeut geuhukôm deungön deunda $1000 tiep meulanggeh.
hypothesis: RUU nyan meukat game video nyang keukeujaman nyang jipeubloe di propinsi California keu na dilee deungon tanda "18" dan jipeugöt penjualan jih keu aneuk miet nyang dihukum deungon denda $ 1000 per pelanggaran.

source: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
reference: Direktur Penuntotan Umum, Kier Starmer QC, geuberi peunyataan beungöh nyoe nyang geupeugöt maklumat penuntotan keu Huhne ngön Pryce.
hypothesis: Direktur Peradilan Publik, Kier Starmer QC, geupeujok pernyataan beungoh nyoe geupeumaklum peunteng keu Huhne dan Pryce.

source: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
reference: Huhne ka geupiyoh droe geuh ngön gobnyan keuneuk igantoe i Kabinet lé Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP geuharap keu geucoek keurija Meuntroe Bisnis nyang geukusong ipeusoh lé Davey.
hypothesis: Huhne ka meunyeleh dan gobnyan akan geu ganti lam Kabinet le MP Ed Davey. MP Norman Lamb diharapkan akan geucok jabatan Menteri Bisnis nyang dipeulheuh le Davey.

source: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
reference: Huhne ngön Pryce geupeuteuente watèe teuka i Peungadilan Westminster Magistrates bak 16 Februari.
hypothesis: Huhne ngon Pryce ka dijadie keu geujak meuhadab di Pengadilan Magistrates Westminster bak 16 Februari.

source: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
reference: Kurubeuen nyang maninggai nakeuh Nicholas Alden, 25, ngön Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback nakeuh ureueng mèe kandranjih.
hypothesis: Peumaté nyan nakeuh Nicholas Alden, 25 thon, dan Zachary Cuddeback, 21 thon.

source: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
reference: Edgar Veguilla lut geuh bak sapai ngön jungkha geuh, seumeuntara Kristoffer Schneider suwah geuoperasi rekonstruksi keu keu muka geuh.
hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla keunong luka bak jaroe ngon rahang seudangkan Kristoffer Schneider tinggai nyang meuheut operasi rekonstruksi untuk wajah jih.

source: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
reference: Sinyata Uka hana meuhasé watèe geupekeu u ulèe ureueng keu limong. Schneider meunyum sakét geuh sabé-sabé, buta siblah mata, bahgian tangkurak nyang gadoh ngön muka geuh nyang geupeugöt keulayi nibak titanium.
hypothesis: Senjata Uka gagal seulama jih teuntra bak ulée sidroe ureuëng keulimong Schneider na sakét nyang hana putôh-putôh, buta bak saboh mata, bagian tengkorak nyang hilang dan wajah nyang teupeuget lom nibak titanium.

source: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
reference: Schneider geuék saksi roet videolink nibak uram USAF i tanoh iejih.
hypothesis: Schneider geu bri keusaksian lewat video link dari pangkalan USAF di nanggroejih.

source: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
reference: I luwa acara uroe Rabu, Carpanedo meutandéng lam duwa balapan individubak Keujuwaraan.
hypothesis: Di seulaén acara Rabu, Carpanedo ka meupaju lam dua bala peumeuleh bak Kejuaraan.

source: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
reference: Nyang keu phôn nakeuh Slalom, pat toeh gobnyan meurumpok saboh Nyang Hana Seuleusoe bak plueng phôn gobnyan. 36 nibak 116 lawanna wasé nyang sama lam balapan nyan.
hypothesis: Nyang phon jih nakeuh Slalom, di sinan jih meuhase Did Not Finish bak bala nyang phon jih. 36 dari 116 peumeujuang na hasil nyang saban bak bala nyan.

source: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
reference: Balapan gobnyan nyang laén, Giant Slalom, peugötjih seuleusoe bak urutan siplôh lam keulompok duek inöng deungön watèe plueng gabongan 4.41.30, 2.11.60 meunét leubèh trep nibak seuleusoe phôn asai Austria Claudia Loesch ngön 1.09.02 meunét leubèh trep nibak seuleusoe keu sikureueng Gyöngyi Dani nibak Hungaria.
hypothesis: Peurangkat jih nyang la'én, Giant Slalom, na geupeuseuleusoe keu siploh lam grup duek inong ngon masa peuseuleusoe 4:41.30, 2:11.60 menit leubeh lambat daripada peungharai keudua Austria Claudia Loesch dan 1:09.02 menit leubeh lambat daripada peungharai sikureueng Gyöngyi Dani dari Hongaria.

source: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
reference: Peuet ureueng meu’èn ski bak kawom duek inöng hana wasé geupeuseuleusoe plueng awak nyan, ngön 45 nibak 117 mandum ureueng meu’èn ski i Giant Slalom hana meuhasé geucok lam reugam peuringkat lam tandéng.
hypothesis: Lhee peumiet di grup duek inong gagal geupeuseuleusoe peumeupah jih, dan 45 dari total 117 peumiet di Giant Slalom gagal dipeumeupah dalam peumeupah.

source: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
reference: Pulisi Madhya Pradesh geuteumèe laptop ngön talipun geunggam nyang icue.
hypothesis: Polisi Madhya Pradesh jiteupue laptop ngon ponsel nyang jicue.

hypothesis: Timbalan Inspektur Jenderal D K Arya geupeugah, "Kamoe ka ta tanggong limong droe ureung nyang ka ji peukaru ureueng inong Swiss nyan dan jicok hape ngon laptop jih".

source: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
reference: Teurdakwa nyan nakeuh Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar ngön Wisnu Kanjar.
hypothesis: Tuntang nyan nakeuh Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar dan Vishnu Kanjar.

source: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
reference: Inspektur pulisi Chandra Shekhar Solanki geukheuen teurdakwa teuka i peungadilan ngön deungön meutop muka.

source: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.

hypothesis: Namun, sopir nyan luka parah bak ulée.

source: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
reference: Jalan dipat musibah nyan teujadi geutop siat seumeuntara layanan darurat geupeuhah keu ureueng mèe moto nibak Audi TT mirah.
hypothesis: Jalan di teumpat kecelakaan nyan ka ditutup sementara sementara layanan darurat dipeubeubaih supir dari Audi TT mirah.

source: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
reference: Gobnyan awaijih ipeuubat bak Rumoh Sakét James Paget i Great Yarmouth.
hypothesis: Jih awai jih di rumah sakit di Rumah Sakit James Paget di Great Yarmouth.

source: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
reference: Gobnyan dudoe ipinah u Rumoh Sakét Addenbrooke i Cambridge.
hypothesis: Jih lheuh nyan di pindahkan u Rumah Sakit Addenbrooke di Cambridge.

source: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
reference: Adekoya mulaphôn nyan ka bak Peungadilan Sheriff Edinburgh deungön itudoh geupohmaté aneuk agamjih.
hypothesis: Adekoya ka di Mahkamah Sheriff Edinburgh ditudoh bak meuröa aneuk jih.

source: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
reference: Gobnyan geutheun sira geupréh dakwaan ngön peursidangan, tapi bukti saksi mata mungkén jeuet reuloh sabab citra gobnyan ka geupublikasi seucara luwah.
