reference: Ureueng jinoe geutuleh peusan bak layeu komputer, hana suwah peutoe droe ngön cui gense.
hypothesis: Jinoe ureung-ureueng ji tuléh haba bak layar komputer, hana peureulèë jak deungo bak peunasah.

source: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
reference: Ureueng jeuet keu mumang jeuetkeu pue keyboard nyan meusapue hana jitubit.
hypothesis: Sidroe jeut ta tanyong mantong apa akan jeut keyboard watee saboh hal baroe teuka.

source: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
reference: Bom fisi jikeureuja meuasai bak prinsip bahwa jipeureulee keukuatan keu peusapat inti deungön proton ngön neutron.
hypothesis: Bom fisi meugantueng bak prinsip bahwa dipakek energi untuk dipeuget saboh inti nyang na le proton ngon neutron.

source: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
reference: Lagѐe tagulong geuritan nyang geuhoen u ateuh buket. Geuplah nukleus lom teuma geupeuleuh ladom keukuatan nyan.
hypothesis: Lagée ta peugulung saboh karet nyang brat u ateueh bukét. Meucre lom inti nyan laju jipeuleueh bacut energi nyan.

source: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
reference: Padum-padum boh atom na inti nyang hana timang nyang meumakna bahwa beukah bacut atawa hana suwah tatulak.
hypothesis: Ladom atom na inti nyang hana stabil yang artinya jih cenderung dipeucre deungon bacut atawa hana padum-padum dorongan.

source: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
reference: Ateuh buleuen jipeugoet dari bate ngön abee. Lapeh iluwa buleuen jikheun krak.
hypothesis: Lumah Buleuen ji peuget dari gunong batée dan abée. Lapas lua Buleuen jiboh nan kerak.

source: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
reference: Krak jih teubai sangkira 70 km i bagian nyang toe ngön teubai 100 km i bagian nyang jiohjih.
hypothesis: Krust nyan kira-kira 70 km teumbok bak sisi deungen dan 100 km teumbok bak sisi deungen.

source: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
reference: Leubѐh lipeh imiyup maria ngown leubѐh teubai imiyup dataran manyang.
hypothesis: Leubeh tipis di bawah maria dan leubèh teumbon di bawah gunong.

source: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
reference: Mungkén na leubѐh jai maria bak arah toe sabab krakjih leubѐh lipeh. Laha leubѐh mudah jiek u ateuh tanoh.
hypothesis: Na mungken leubeh le maria di sisi deungen kareuna kerak nyan leubeh tipis.

source: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
reference: Tiori kontent pusat jih bak jitume pue nyang peugoet ureueng meugrak atawa meutarékjih.
hypothesis: Teori konten terpusat bak mita peue nyang jeut ureung tik atau menarik keu awaknyan.

source: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
reference: Tiori-tiori nyoe jipeutunyoek bahwa ureueng na peureulee ngön/atawa heut meuteunte nyang ka meuleukap bak droe watѐe awaknyan rayek sampoe tuha.
hypothesis: Teori nyo geu sugesti bahwa ureung na kebutuhan dan/atau keinginan tertentu yeng ka diinternalisasi seiring awak nyan matang jeut keu ureung dewasa.

source: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
reference: Tiori-tiori nyoe jikaloen bak pue teuntang ureueng-ureueng meuteunte nyang peugoet awaknyan galak jipubuet hai-hai nyang awaknyan pubuet ngön hai-hai pue nyang mantông nyang i silingka awaknyan nyang neukpeugot awanyan pubuet atawa hana pubuet hai-hai meuteunte.
hypothesis: Teori nyo ji pandang peue na bak ureung tertentu yang jeut keu peue nyang jeut keu peue nyang awaknyan peubuet dan peue nyang jeut keu peue nyang na lam lingkungan awaknyan nyang jeut keu peue nyang hana jeut keu peue nyang hana jeut keu peue nyang ka awaknyan peubuet.

source: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
reference: Duwa boh tiori konten nyang ka meuceuhu nyankeuh tiori Hirarki neuhet Maslow ngön tiori duwa faktor Hertzberg.
hypothesis: Dua teori konten populer adalah Teori Hierarki Kebutuhan Maslow ngen Teori Dua Faktor Hertzberg.

source: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
reference: Seucara umum, duwa boh peukateun jitubiet watѐe menejer geumulai pimpin ureueng keureuja nyang ilikot awaknyan. Salah saboh ujoeng spektrum jiujoe keu teutap jeuet keu salah sidroe ureueng agam” (atawa ureueng inoeng).
hypothesis: Secara umum, dua perilaku jeut muncul wate manajer mulai pimpin rekan-rekan awai jih. Sidroe ujung spektrum nyo nyo cuba tinggai sidroe dari ureung agam (atau cewek).

source: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
reference: Menejer tipe nyoe jirasa sosah peugot peunutoh nyang hana meuceuhu, geupubuet buet disiplin, evaluasi keureuja, jok tanggung jaweub ngön lakee tanggong jaweub ureueng.
hypothesis: Jenis manajer nyo na kesulitan untuk geucok keputusan nyang hana populer, meujak tindakan disiplin, evaluasi kinerja, meupeugadeh tanggung jawab, dan meukheun ureung-ureung bertanggung jawab.

source: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
reference: Bak ujoeng laen spektrum, sidroe-droe ureueng meu ubah-ubahjeuet keu ureueng nyang hana jituri meurasa suwah jiubah mandum nyang ka jipeugot keulompok ngön jeuet peugot ata droeih.
hypothesis: Bak ujong nyang laén, sidroe meu-ubah jeuet keu sidroe individu nyang hana teupat nyang meurasa jih nyan atawa jih nyan harus meu ubah mandum nyang ka ji peubuet tim nyan dan ji peujeuet jih keudroe.

source: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
reference: Adak meurangkaban, peupimpin bak seuneulheuh tanggong jaweub ateuh meuhase ngön hana meuhase keu keulompok.
hypothesis: Lagée toh, pemimpin nakeuh nyang bertanggung jawab keu keberhasilan dan kegagalan tim.

source: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
reference: Peukateun nyoe kayém meu akibat karu antara peumimpin ngön anggota keulompok tim laenjih.
hypothesis: Keujadian nyo seureng meuakibat bak peucang antara pimpinan ngen awak tim laen.

source: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
reference: Keulompok Virtual na keuh standar utama nyang sama deungön keulompok konvensional, tapih na peubeda bacut.
hypothesis: Tim virtual dipeugöt keu standar keunggulan yeng sama deungen tim konvensional, teutapi na perbedaan subtle.

source: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
reference: Anggota keulompok virtual kayém meufungsi sebagoe titek kontak keu keulompok fisik langsông awak nyan.
hypothesis: Anggota tim virtual seureng berfungsi seubagai titik kontak untuk kelompok fisik awak nyan langsong.

source: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
reference: Awak nyan kayém na leubѐh jai otonomi nibak anggota keulompok konvensional sabab keulompok awak nyan na meurumpok seusuai deungön zona watѐe nyang meubeda nyang mungkén han jimuphom le manajemen lokal awak nyan.
hypothesis: Awaknyan seureng na autonomitas leubeh le daripada anggota tim konvensional kareuna tim jih jeut meurumpok sesuai ngon zona waktu yeng bervariasi yeng hana jeut dipahami le manajemen lokal jih.

source: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
reference: Wujud nyang nyata dari "keulompok hana deuh" nyang seubetoijih (Larson ngön LaFasto, 1989, p109) nyan keuh komponen unik nibak keulompok virtual sit.
hypothesis: Kehadiran saboh tim nyata nyang hana deuh deuh (Larson dan LaFasto, 1989, p109) adalah cit komponen unik dari tim virtual.

source: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
reference: "Keulompok hana deuh" nyan keuh keulompok manajemen nyang maseng-maseng anggota peulapor. Keulompok hana deuh peuteutap standar keu tip anggota.
hypothesis: Tim nyang hana deuh deuh deuh nakeuh tim manajemen nyang awak nyan lapor keu. Tim nyang hana deuh deuh deuh nyan geupeutrang standar keu awak nyan.

source: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
reference: Pakon saboh organisasi nyan geutem buet peuabeh watѐe keu geupeudong saboh organisasi meureuno? Saboh tujuan geupeugot konsep organisasi meureuno keu praktek nakeuh inovasi.
hypothesis: Pakon saboh organisasi keuneuk geujak liwat proses nyang meupeutamah watee keu geupeudong saboh organisasi peurunoe? Salah saboh tujuan untuk geupeuget konsep peurunoe organisasi lam praktek jih nakeuh inovasi.

source: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
reference: watѐe hai-hai nyang peureulee beuna nyangengui ngön get meulingke ban saboh bahagian nyang udep dari saboh organisasi, daya cipta ngön hai nyang aseuli nyanjeuet keu buet.
hypothesis: Watee mandum sumber daya nyang na di gunakan secara efektif di mandum departemen fungsional organisasi, kreativitas ngen kecerdasan jeut terjadi.

source: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
reference: Nyanjeuet wase, buet dari saboeh organisasi nyang dikeureuja sama ban mandum keu geupeuthen meubagoe hai nyang meulinteng akan geuba lam saboh buet inovasi nyang baro keu tajok pue nyang dipeureule le ureueng nyang ngui.
hypothesis: Akibat jih, proses organisasi bekerja sama untuk jipeumeunang hambatan jeut jiba proses inovatif baro untuk memenuhi kebutuhan pelanggan.

source: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
reference: Sigolom saboh organisasi nyan jeuet geu inovasi, peumimpin suwah geupeuna saboh budaya inovasi saban cit keu meubagi euleume ngön meureuno organisasi.
hypothesis: Sebelum saboh organisasi jeut inovatif, kepemimpinan harus menciptakan budaya inovasi meunan cit pengetahuan bersama dan pembelajaran organisasi.

source: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
reference: Angel (2006), geupeutrang akan cara nyang hana putoh keu saboh cara keu tulong organisasi keu meureumpok level nyang leubѐh manyang bak buet.
hypothesis: Angel (2006), geu jelaskan pendekatan Kontinuum seubagai metode yeng dipakek untuk membantu organisasi meugeumeuh tingkat kinerja yeng lubeh rayek.

source: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
reference: Data euleume saraf biologi nyan geupeuna bukti nyang nyata keu cara saboh teori keu geu kalon wase. Nyankeuh nyoe di peu ubit wilayah keu geumeusetot ngön nyoe jeuet keu leubѐh teupat.
hypothesis: Data neurobiologis meujok bukti fisik untuk pendekatan teoritis untuk penyelidikan kognitif. Oleh karena nyan jih meucak wilayah penelitian dan ji peujeuet jih leubeh teukeurita.

source: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
reference: Hubongan nibak euleume peunyaket utak ngön peukateun nyankeuh nyang tulong para euleumewan lam geumeusetot ureuengnyan.
hypothesis: Hubungan antara patologi otak ngen perilaku geu dukung para ilmuwan lam penelitian awak nyan.

source: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
reference: Nyoe ka diteupue nibak jameun koen bahawa meubeudaluka nyang keunong lam utak, trauma, luka, ngön tumor nyan na peungaroh keu peukateun ureueng ngön jeuet keu seubab bak fungsi mental.
hypothesis: Ka treb that teutap bahwa macam-macam kerusakan uteun, trauma, luka, ngen tumor meuakibat bak perilaku dan meuakibat perubahan lam padum-padum fungsi mental.

source: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
reference: Dengön dibeudoh euleume teknologi ka geupeujeuet tanyoe keu takalon ngön ta meureuno bentuk utak ngön cara nyang hana tom na takalon awai.
hypothesis: Meulaboh teknologi baro jeut ta kalon dan ta seulidek struktur otak ngon proses yang hana ta kalon seugolom nyan.

source: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
reference: Nyoe keuh nyang geubrie keu geutanyoe jai that euleueme ngön meubago benda keujeuet tabangun saboh model keu peuleumah nyang akan geutulong geutanyoe bak ta meuphom akan pue nyang keujadian nyang na lam utak geutanyo.
hypothesis: Nyoe tapeupeunoh keu geutanyoe le informasi ngen bahan untuk tapeuget model simulasi nyang membantu geutanyoe meuphom proses lam pikeran geutanyoe.

source: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
reference: Adakpi AI nyan nah ai nyang kong lam euleume sains hayal, AI nyan jipeudong saboh cabeung lam euleume sains komputer, nyang meuhubong noen peukateun, meureuno ngön caroengjih saboh meusen lam adaptasi.
hypothesis: Meskipun AI na konotasi yang teuga dari fiksi ilmiah, AI membentuk cabang yang sangat penting dari ilme komputer, nyang meuurusan deungen perilaku, pembelajaran dan adaptasi cerdas dalam mesin.

source: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
reference: Geumeusetot lam AI nyan na roh keu peuget meusen nyan beu jipubuet buet keu otomatis nyang peureulee keu peukaten nyang hayeu.
hypothesis: Penelitian dalam AI melibatkan peuget mesin untuk otomatis tugas yang merlukeun perilaku cerdas.

source: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
reference: Tamsejih na roh keu kontrol, reuncana ngön boh jadwal, jeuet keu i jaweub diagnosa ngön pertanyaan ureueng nyang geungui, lagѐe cit meuphom kheuet ngön jaro, su atawa wajah.
hypothesis: Contoh jih na kontrol, perencanaan ngen jadwal, kemampuan untuk menjawab diagnosis dan pertanyaan pelanggan, serta pengenalan tulisan jaroe, suara ngen wajah.

source: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
reference: Hai-hai lagѐe nyan kajeuet keu cabeung euleume nyang meubeda, lage takalon beu timang bak ta brie jawaban keu masalah nyang na lam udep.
hypothesis: Hal-hal lagee nyan ka jeut disiplin yeng terpisah, yeng fokus keu peuseuleusoe masalah kehidupan nyata.

source: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
reference: Sistem AI nyoe jino kayém dingui lam bideung ekonomi, ubat, meusen ngön militer, lage nyang ka dipeugot le ladomkomputer rumoh ngön aplikasi software video keumeu’en.
hypothesis: Sistem AI jinoe seureng dipakek di bidang ekonomi, kedokteran, teknik ngen militer, lage yang ka dipeuget di padum boh aplikasi perangkat lunak komputer rumoh dan video game.

source: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
reference: Jak meu’en nyan nakeuh bahagian nyang rayeuk lam dum glah. Kayém that sidroe guree galak geuba murid u teumpat-teumpat nyang hana dijak moto bes sebagoe saboh pilehan.
hypothesis: Peuet nyang jak u padang nakeuh saboh bagian rayek nibak saboh kelas.

source: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
reference: Tehnologi geupeutaba solusi deungon saweu lapangan virtual. Peulajarjeuet meukalon artefak meuseum artefak, saweu akuarium, atawa takjub keu seni nyang ceudah sira duek deungon tingkat awak nyan.
hypothesis: Teknologi na peuseumahan solusi ngon kunjungan lapangan virtual. Murid-murid jeut ji pandang artefak museum, jak u akuarium, atawa meunyo ji pujoe seni indah seudangkan ji duek ngon kelas jih.

source: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
reference: Geubri saweu lapangan virtual nakeuh saboh cara nyang get keu heut bak saboh saweu ngön geubri peungalaman deungön tingkat ukeu.
hypothesis: Meubagi perjalanan lapangan secara virtual adalah cara yang bagus untuk meurif tentang perjalanan dan meubagi pengalaman ngen kelas masa ukeu.

source: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
reference: Miseujih, tip thon peulajar nibak Sikula Bennet bak Carolina Utara geupeugot saboh situs web teuntang saweu awak nyan u ibu kuta nanggroe, tip thon situs web jipeubaro teuma, tapih bagoe awai dikeubah seucara online keu jipeugot saboh kliping.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, sigoe thon mahasiswa dari Bennet School di North Carolina ji desain situs web tentang perjalanan awak nyan u Nanggroe Nanggroe, sigoe thon situs web ji ubah, tapi versi awai dipeulara online keu ji peumeujabat seubagai buku scrapbook.

source: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
reference: Blogjeuet cit geubantu meutamah get peulajar geuteumuleh. Seudangkan peulajar kayém peuphôn peungalaman blog awak nyan deungön tata basa ngön ejaan nyang beurangkaho, geujak ureueng kaloen umumjih meuubah nyan.
hypothesis: Blog jeut cit membantu peugöt tulisan aneuk miet. Sementara aneuk miet seureng mulai pengalaman blog jih deungon tatabahasa dan ejaan yang hana teupat, kehadiran penonton umum jih meu ubah nyan.

source: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
reference: watѐe peulajar kayém jeuet keu ureung kaloen paleng kritis, peunuleh blog mulai geumeurenoe keu meutamah get teumuleh bah hana jikritek.
hypothesis: Kareuna mahasiswa seureng jeut keu penonton nyang paleng kritis, penulis blog mulai meujuang untuk ji peuget tulisan yang leubeh get mangat hana ji kritik.

source: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
reference: Pih blog "geupaksa peulajar keu leubѐh meuphom teuntang donya silingka awak nyan." Peurle keu geujok minat ureueng kalon jitubiet seumangat peulajar keu caroeng ngön meunarek (Toto, 2004).
hypothesis: Meunan cit blog "meupeujeuet aneuk miet leubeh meupeungeut tentang donya di sekitar jih". Keukayaan untuk meukheun minat penonton meukasu keu aneuk miet mangat jeut keu bijak dan menarik (Toto, 2004).

source: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
reference: Blog nakeuh saboh peukakah nyang woe seumangat kolaborasi, ngön geupeuseumangat peulajar keu geupeulwuah meurenoe jioh leupah uroe sikula tradisional.
hypothesis: Bloging nakeuh saboh alat nyang meupeugöt kolaborasi, dan geu dorong aneuk miet keu ji peuget peundidikan leubeh leupah nibak uroe peurunoe.

source: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
reference: Geungui blog nyang seusuai "jeuet geupeudaya peulajar keu jeuet leubѐh analitis ngön kritis; rhot aktif geutanggapi materi internet, peulajar jeuet peutente teupat awak nyan lam kontek ureueng laen’ geuteumuleh cara geukaloen awak nyan bak haba-haba meuteunte (Oravec, 2002).
hypothesis: "Penggunaan blog yang paih" jeut meubri kuasa keu aneuk miet jeut keu lebih analitik ngen kritis; melalui aktif meubacut bak bahan internet, aneuk miet jeut mendefinisikan posisi awak nyan lam konteks tulisan ureung laen serta menguraikan perspektif awak nyan keudroe bak isu-isu tertentu (Oravec, 2002).

source: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
reference: Ottawa nakeuh Kanada nyang ceudah, ibu kuta duwa basa ngön geupeukaleon mandum teumpat keuneubah seuni ngön museum nyang geupeuleumah Kanada awai ngön jinoe.
hypothesis: Ottawa nakeuh nang nanggroe Kanada nyang meugah, dua basa dan na padum boh galeri seni ngen museum nyang peugöt masa jameun ngon masa kini Kanada.

source: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
reference: Leubѐh jioh u tunong nakeuh ie terjun Niagara ngön blah baroh nakeuh rumoh alam nyang ceudah Muskoka ngön alheueh nibak nyan.
hypothesis: Leubeh di seulatan nakeuh Air Terjun Niagara ngen di utara nakeuh rumoh keu keindahan alam nyang hana dieksploitasi di Muskoka ngen di lua nyan.

source: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
reference: Mandum hai nyoe ngön leubѐh geupeurayeuk Ontario seubagoe peu nyang jipeusangka muasaih Kanada le ureueng luwa.
hypothesis: Banmandum hal nyoe dan le jih meupeuteubit Ontario seubagai nyang dianggap khas Kanada le ureung luwa.

source: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
reference: Wilayah luwah leubѐh jioh u baroh jareung ureueng tinggai ngön meupadum nakeuh uteun nyang hana ureueng tinggai.
hypothesis: Daerah rayek di utara sangat jarang penduduk dan na cit padang pasi yang hana ji tinggai.

source: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
reference: Keu geubandeng populasi nyang peukeujot le ureueng: na leubѐh jai ureueng Afrika Ameurika tinggai bak AS nibak ureueng nanggroe Kanada.
hypothesis: Keu peubandengan populasi nyang mengejutkan le ureung: Na le ureung Afrika Amerika nyang tinggai di Amerika Serikat daripada na warganegara Kanada.

source: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
reference: Pulo-pulo Afrika Timue nakeuh bak Samudra Hindia bak meuhalak Pasi Afrika Timue.
hypothesis: Kepulauan Afrika Timu na di La'ôt Hindia di seulatan Afrika.

source: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
reference: Madagaskar nyankeuh nyang paleng rayeuk ngön beunua droe ih lam hai meulatang kleut.
hypothesis: Madagascar adalah nyang paleng rayek, dan saboh benua nyang seubalek jih meunyoe ka trok bak binatang buas.

source: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
reference: Ladom pulo-pulo ubeut nyankeuh nanggroe ka meurdeka, atawa meusangkot ngön basa Prancis, teumpat eh bineh pasi ngön ceudah lagoina.
hypothesis: Leubeh le pulo-pulo ubit nyan nakeuh bansa independen, atawa meuhubongan ngon Prancis, dan dikenal seubagai resor pantai mewah.

source: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
reference: Ureueng Arab pih geume Islam u bumoe, ngön geupeureulee seucara meugah i Comoros ngön Mayotte.
hypothesis: Ureuëng Arab cit geuba Islam u nanggroe-nanggroe nyan, dan nyan meutabu that di Comoros dan Mayotte.

source: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
reference: Peungaroh ngön peunjajahan Eropa ka jimulai bak abad keu-15, watee ureueng Portugeh Vasco da Gama geutumee Cape Route dari Eropa u India.
hypothesis: Pengaruh Eropa ngen kolonialisme dimulai bak abad keu-15, saat penjelajah Portugis Vasco da Gama meurumpok rute Cape dari Eropa u India.

source: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
reference: Blah wilayah baroh nyoe jiboh ceu le Sahel, tunoeng ngön barat le samudra Atlantik.
hypothesis: Di utara wilayah nyan dibatasi le Sahel, ngen di seulatan ngen barat le Samudra Atlantik.

source: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
reference: Ureueng inoeng: nyoe jisurat bahwasajih tiep jamѐe inoeng geupeugah droe geuh kalheueh geu meukawen, leupah nibak status beutoi kalheueh geumeunikah.
hypothesis: Wanita: Disarankan bahwa mandum inong nyang jak uengkot marit jipeugah bahwa awak nyan ka meukawen, padum-padum status perkawinan nyang nyata.

source: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
reference: Nyoe meutuloeng sit keu geusok encin (nyan sit hana deuh meuhai that).
hypothesis: Muncul cit keu geungui cincin (cuma hana nyang deuh jih mahal that.

source: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
reference: Ureueng inoeng peureulee beu geuthee droe geuh bahwasajih parak budaya nyan jeut ku musabab pue nyang jikira seubagoe seumalee, jium, dsj.
hypothesis: Ureuëng inong harus sadar bahwa perbedaan budaya jeut meuakibat jih jeut keu peucaruhan dan hana biasa jih seurapa, teudrob bak jaroe, dll.

source: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
reference: Beugap bak taglhoeng gaki, bek geusuen keu ta peutheun droe (parak budaya atawa hana, nyan hanajeuet keu hai nyang jroeh!).
hypothesis: Beutôi that-that hana neutulak ureueng agam, dan bék takot keu neutem peudong peukara awak (peurbedaan budaya atawa hana, nyan hana jeut keu masalah!).

source: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
reference: Kuta nyang ka maju Casablanca geupeudoeng le ureueng meulaot Barber bak abad keu-10 SM, ngön geucok le Fanisia, Romawi, ngön Merenid seubagoe peulabuhan nyang pah teumpat nyang geukheun Anfa.
hypothesis: Banda modern Casablanca didirikan le neulayan Berber bak abad keu-10 SM, dan dipakek le Fenisia, Romawi, ngen Merenids seubagai pelabuhan strategis yang geukheun Anfa.

source: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
reference: Portugis jipeuancoe ngön jipeudoeng lom nyan nanjih Casa Branca, sit keu jikubah lheueh geumpa bumoe thon 1755.
hypothesis: Portugis geupeuhanco dan geupeudong lom di bawah nama Casa Branca, hanya untuk geupeulahé lheuh geumpa bumoe bak thon 1755.

source: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
reference: Raja Maroko geupeudoeng lom kuta nyan sebagoe Daru I-Badya ngön geuboh nan Casablanca le ureueng Spanyol nyang meukat nyang geupeudoeng asai bloe publoe hinan.
hypothesis: Sultan Maroko geupeudong lom banda nyan seubagoe Daru l-Badya dan geu peugöt nama Casablanca le padum droe pedagang Spanyol nyang geupeudong pangkalan dagang di sinan.

source: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
reference: Casablanca nyankeuh salah saboh teumpat nyang paleng lagak bak tajak meubloe ubena i Maroko.
hypothesis: Casablanca nakeuh saboh teumpat nyang hana menarik keu meukat di mandum Maroko.

source: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
reference: Silingka Madinah tuha, mangat tatumee teumpat-teumpat jipubloe dabeuh-dabeuh tradisiaonal Maroko, lagѐe tajin, tembikar, sibeurangkapue muasai kulet, hookah, ngön meubagoe jinѐh geegaw, tapih mandum keu jamѐe troek.
hypothesis: Di sekitar Medina jameun nyan mudah untuk meurumpok teumpat-teumpat nyang ji peubloe barang-barang tradisional Maroko, lage tagine, keramik, barang-barang kulit, hookah, dan seumacam geegaws, teuma mandum nyan keu wisatawan.

source: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
reference: Goma nyan kuta urosan teumaca bak Nanggroe Republik Kongo bagian paleng timu toe ngon nanggroe Rwanda.
hypothesis: Goma nakeuh saboh banda wisata di Republik Demokratik Kongo di timu nyang paleng rab ngon Rwanda.

source: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
reference: Bak thon 2002 Goma ka anco le larva gunong apui Nyiragongo watee ulak meuhamboe u taloe jalan leubeh lom bak pusat kuta.
hypothesis: Bak thon 2002 Goma dihanco le lava dari gunung berapi Nyiragongo nyang meukubu leuh rayek kota, terutama pusat kota.

source: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
reference: Adak pih Goma nyan sep aman, tiep-tiep ureueng kunjong di luwa Goma wajeb di seulidei keu meuphom nyang bahwa prang mantong na nibak provinsi Kivu blah Utara.
hypothesis: Sementara Goma aman, kunjungan di luwa Goma harus diteumeu seudia untuk meuphom keadaan prang yang mantong na di propinsi Kivu Utara.

source: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
reference: Kuta nyan nakeuh pih uram keu ek gunong apui Nyiragongo nyan ngon teumaca keu kalon Gorila Gunong dengon yum murah bak Afrika.
hypothesis: Banda nyo cit adalah pangkalan untuk meulipat gunung berapi Nyiragongo seurta sebagoe dari pengesan Gorila Gunong termahal di Afrika.

source: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
reference: Droeneuh jeut neungui boda-boda (honda siwa) keu wet-wet lingka Goma. Biasa ongkohjih (lokal) 500 Francs Kongo miseue neuk jak nyang toe-toe.
hypothesis: Droeneuh jeut neu pakek boda-boda (taxi motor) untuk neu jak u Goma. Harga biasa (lokal) nakeuh ~ 500 franc Kongo untuk perjalanan pendek.

source: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
reference: Ijampue ngön bit hanjeuet jipeutubiet, "Timbuktu" ka jipeuguna seubagoe metafora keu nanggroe-nanggroe nyang jioh nyang ceudah lagoina.
hypothesis: Digabungkan deungen ketidakpeluang relatif jih, "Timbuktu" ka dipakek seubagai metafora untuk nanggroe-nanggroe eksotik, jiôh.

source: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
reference: Uroe nyoe, Timbuktu nakeuh kuta nyang gasien, adakpih martabatjih jeuet keu kuta seubagoe teumpat jak tamasya, ngön na saboh bandara.
hypothesis: Jinoe, Timbuktu nakeuh saboh banda nyang gasien, meskipun reputasi jih jeut keu daya tarik wisata, dan na bandara.

source: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
reference: Bak thon 1990, ka geutamah bak dafta situs waresan donya lam bahya, sabab ancaman cot meu anoe.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1990, nyan di tambahkan bak daftar situs warisan donya nyang na lam bahaya, kareuna ancaman pasir padang pasi.

source: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
reference: Nyankeuh salah saboh nyang phôn jitheun nibak Keuajaiban Meuteunte Donya Afrika Hery Luois Gate’PBS.
hypothesis: Nyan adalah salah saboh peugadeh utama seulama acara khusus PBS Henry Louis Gates' Wonders of the African World.

source: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
reference: Kuta nyoe sep brat deuh deungön kuta-kuta nyang laenjih bak abad nyoe, sabab ureueng Arab leubѐh jai bakat nibak ureueng Afrika.
hypothesis: Banda nyoe meubeda that deungen kota-kota nanggroë nyan, kareuna na le bakat Arab daripada Afrika.

source: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
reference: Kruger National Park (KNP) i baroh-timue Afrika Tunoeng ngön meuhalak ubena ceu Mozambik blah timue, Zimbabwe na roet baroh, ngön bak ceu blah tunoeng nakeuh Krueng Buya.
hypothesis: Taman Nasional Kruger (KNP) na di timu utara Afrika Selatan dan meucre di seulatan perbatasan Mozambik di timu, Zimbabwe di utara, dan perbatasan selatan nakeuh Krueng Krokodil.

source: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
reference: Keu seuneulheueh taman 19.500 km² ngön ibahgi keu 14 wilayah mangat takaloen nyang meuulaen, tiep-tiep droe sapue kheun keu meubagoe meulatang kleut nyan.
hypothesis: Taman nyan jimat 19.500 km2 dan dipeudeng lam 14 zona alam nyang berbeda, masing-masing nyang geu dukung binatang buas nyang berbeda.

source: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
reference: Nyan nakeuh saboh antara piyasan-piyasan nibak Afrika Tunoeng ngön nyan dikheun hai nyang teuleubѐh nibak Taman Nasional Afrika Tunoeng (SANParks).
hypothesis: Nyan nakeuh salah saboh atraksi utama Afrika Selatan dan dianggap sebagai pusat taman nasional Afrika Selatan (SANParks).

source: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
reference: Deungon mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Tunoeng, nyan na buet keumiet siuroe-uroe ngön euungkoh tamoeng bak taman nyan.
hypothesis: Lagee mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan, na biaya konservasi dan akses harian keu taman.

source: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
reference: Nyan pih jeuet keu paidah keu sidroe ureueng nyang bloe saboh Keureutu Kleuet, nyan seudiya rauh tamong u pue keuh taman bak Afrika Tunoeng nyang ka geupileh atawa mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Tunoeng.
hypothesis: mungken cit meuguna untuk sidroe untuk meukat Wild Card, yang meubri akses keu dua pilihan taman di Afrika Selatan atawa mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan.

source: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
reference: Pulo Hong Kong dibri dairah Hong Kong nyan nanjih ngön nyankeuh teumpat nyang jai turis peujeuet keu pusat nyang phôn.
hypothesis: Pulo Hong Kong meubri nan wilayah Hong Kong dan nakeuh teumpat nyang ji anggap le wisatawan seubagoe pusat utama.

source: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
reference: Geudoeng-geudoeng nyang meubareh nyan peugot gareh langet Hong Kong nyan dipeusaban deungön gamba balok meucahya nyang dipeugot deuh deungon ie nyang troeh nibak Peulabohan Victoria.
hypothesis: Parade bangunan yang jeut keu cakrawala Hong Kong ka ji peusaban ngen bagan bar yang meukilat yang jeut keu nyata le kehadiran ie Victoria Harbour.

source: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
reference: Keu meutumee peumandangan nyang paleng got bak Hong Kong, neuminah nibak Pulo ngön neujak u Kowloon blahdeh pasi.
hypothesis: Untuk meukalon pemandangan Hong Kong yang paleng jroh, tinggai pulo nyan dan jak u pinggir pantai Kowloon nyang na di seukeulileng nyan.

source: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
reference: Nyang paleng jai nibak cara dipeugot dairah kuta Pulo Hong Kong nyang hayeu nyan nyankeuh dipeusapat deungon punoh bak tanoh nyang jireklamasi seupanyang pasi blah baroh.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek rayek pembangunan perkotaan Pulau Hong Kong dipakek padet di darat yang di reklaim seulama pantai utara.

source: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
reference: Nyoe teumpat nyang peunjajah asai Inggreh cok seubagoe atra droe ngön meunyoe gata mita keu peuninggai jameun masa peunjajah, nyoekeuh saboh teumpat nyang got keu neupeuphôn.
hypothesis: Nyoe teumpat yang ji peuduek kolonial Inggris seubagoe atra droejih dan meunyo awak mita bukti masa jameun kolonial wilayah nyan, nyoe teumpat nyang jroh untuk dimulai.

source: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
reference: Sundarbans nakeuh dairah pasi bak bangka nyang paleng rayek i donya, meubeunteueng 80 km (50 mi) u dairah dalam Bangladesh ngön India dari pasi.
hypothesis: Sundarbans nakeuh sabuk mangrove pesisir nyang rayek di donya, nyang meuhubong 80 km (50 mil) u dalam wilayah barat Bangladesh ngon India dari pasisir.

source: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
reference: Sundarbans ka dipeunyata keu Teumpat Wareh Donya UNESCO. Dairah uteun lam wilayah India nyan dikheun Taman Nasional Sundarbans.
hypothesis: Sundarbans ka geu peutrang seubagoe Situs Warisan Dunia UNESCO. Bagian uteun lam wilayah India geuboh nan Taman Nasional Sundarbans.

source: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
reference: Uteunjih nyan pih koen alue bakau sagai — nyan ditamong ladom dari rimba-rimba kha nyang tinggai nyang dilee dikhop tanoh luwah Gangetic.
hypothesis: Gampông nyan hana cuma pantôn mangrove bah pih  nyan na hubôngan na padum boh teumpat nyang na tinggai bak gle raya nyang kalheh meukabông dataran Gangetic.

source: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
reference: Sundarbans dikhop saboh wilayah 3.850 km², sangkira sa per lhee nyan dikhop ngön ie/wilayah paya.
hypothesis: Sundarbans meukureueng wilayah 3.850 km2, di antara nyan kira-kira lhee dari nyan meukureueng di wilayah ie/buah rawa.

source: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
reference: Nibak thon 1966 Sundarbans jeuet keu saboh suaka keu meulatang juwah, ngön nyan keunira jinoe na 400 rimueng Royal Bengal ngön sangkira 30.000 rusa nyang deuh bak wilayah nyan.
hypothesis: Sejak 1966 Sundarbans ka jeut keu taman binatang liar, dan dipeugalak jinoe na 400 harimau Benggala karajaan ngen kira-kira 30.000 rusa nyang na patong di daerah nyan.

source: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
reference: Moto Bus dibungka tasiyon moto bes lingkeue dairah (meukoh krueng) seupanyang uroe, adak kayémjih, khususjih nyang meujak u timu ngön Jakar/Bumthang jipeuhah antara poh 06:30 ngön poh 07:30.
hypothesis: Bus-bus nyang jak dari stasiun bus antar-distrik (seberang krueng) seulama uroe, meskipun le, terutama yang jak u timu dan Jakar/Bumthang geutinggai antara 06:30 dan 07:30.

source: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
reference: Seubap moto bes lingkeue dairah nyan kayém peunoh, nyan dibrithee keu neubloe karcih bak padum uroe sigohlomjih.
hypothesis: Kareuna bis antar kabupaten seureng peunoh, nyan na keuh meupujoe untuk meukat tiket seugolom na padum uroe.

source: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
reference: Dum dairah-dairah nyan diseudiya Moto Bus Peluncur Jeupang, nyang sanyum ngön kong.
hypothesis: Leuh daerah dipakek le Bus Coaster Jepang ubit, yeng nyaman ngen kuat.

source: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
reference: Moto taksi sajan nyankeuh saboh hai nyang bagah ngön sanyum keu jak u teumpat-teumpat lam seulingka, lagѐe Paro (Nu 150) ngön Punakha (Nu 200).
hypothesis: Taxi bersama adalah cara yeng sigra dan nyaman untuk geujak u teumpat-teumpat yeng na di sekitar, lage Paro (Nu 150) ngen Punakha (Nu 200).

source: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
reference: Tutue Krueng Oyapock nyankeuh tutue yang dipeudong ngoen taloe. Nyan di lingkeue krueng Oyapock meuhubong ngon kuta-kuta di Oipoque di Brazil ngon Saint-Georges de l’Oyapock di French Guiana.
hypothesis: Jembatan Krueng Oyapock nakeuh saboh jembatan nyang na di la'ôt kawat. jembatan nyan meujampu ngon Krueng Oyapock keu meuhubông banda-banda Oiapoque di Brasil ngon Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock di Guiana Prancis.

source: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
reference: Dua boh meunara manyang u ateuhjih 83 mete, panyang u sampengjih 378 mete ngon na dua boh rot nyang luwahjih 3.50 mete.
hypothesis: Dua meunara nyan meugeunta u manyang 83 meter, nyan 378 meter panyang dan na dua jalur 3,50 meter luwah.

source: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
reference: Ceue keu manyang di yup tutue nyan 15 mete. Buet peugot tutue nyan lheueh bak Agustus 2011, nyan han dibuka keu ureueng jak sampoe Maret 2017.
hypothesis: Jaroe vertikal di yup jembatan nyan 15 meter. Peugot jih ka seuleusoe bak Agustus 2011, hana jibuka keu lalu lintas sampoe bak Maret 2017.

source: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
reference: Tutue nyan reuncanajih dibuka peunoh keu operational bak September 2017, watë teumpat-teumpat keu peutren dabeuh ureueng Brazil nyan ka lheueh dipeugot.
hypothesis: Jembatan nyan dijadwalkan untuk beroperasi seucara penuh bak September 2017, wate pos pemeriksaan bea cukai Brasil diharap akan selesai.

source: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
reference: Guarani nyankeuh keulompok asai nyang paleng peunteng nyang jiduek bak teumpat nanjih jinoe Timu Paraguay, meuudep ban meupinah-pinah sira jak let meunatang meurunoe nyang geupubuet meugo keuudep cit.
hypothesis: Guaraní adalah kelompok asli yeng paleng signifikan yeng meu-idu di timu Paraguay, yeng meu-idu seubagai pemburu semi-nomad yeng cit meu-praktik pertanian subsistence.

source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
reference: Dairah Chaco nyankeuh rumoh keu keulompok suku asai lagee Guaycuru ngoen Payagua, nyang udep deungon meuburu, meukumpoi ngoen keumawe.
hypothesis: Wilayah Chaco nakeuh rumoh keu kelompok-kelompok adat la'én lage Guaycurú ngen Payaguá, nyang udep deungen meujeu, meukumpul ngen meucang.

source: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
reference: Lam abad keu-16 Paraguay, sigohlomjih dikheuen "Provinsi Raya Nyang Jiduek le Ureueng India", nyan lahe dari hase peukara peunjajah Spanyol deungon keulompok asai nyang disinan.
hypothesis: Bak abad keu-16, Paraguay, nyang awai jih jih geukheun "Provinsi Giant of the Indies", lahé seubagoe akibat dari pertemuan penakluk Spanyol ngen kelompok asli asli.

source: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
reference: Bansa Spanyol geupuphon watë meujajah nyang trepjih sampoe lhee abad.
hypothesis: Ureuëng Spanyol mulai periode kolonialisasi nyang berlangsung selama lhee abad.

source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
reference: Watë dipeudong Asunción bak thon 1537, Paraguay jeuet dipeutheun dum peurangeui ureueng asai ngoen identitahjih.
hypothesis: Sejak peundirian Asunción bak thon 1537, Paraguay ka meuhase dipeutahan le karakter dan identitas asli jih.

source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
reference: Argentina nyan got dituri seubap na salah saboh tim polo ngoen peumeu’en nyang paleng got i dônya.
hypothesis: Argentina terkenal that keu na salah saboh tim polo dan pemain terbaik di donya.

source: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
reference: Turnamen sithon sigo nyang paleng rayeuk dipeugot lam buleuen Desember bak lapangan polo i Las Cañitas.
hypothesis: Turnamen paleng rayek thon nyan geupeuget bak buleuen Desember di lapangan polo di Las Cañitas.

source: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
reference: Turnamen ngoen acara tadong nyang leubeh ubeut jeuet sit neukalon hinoe bak laen watë lam saboh thon.
hypothesis: Turnamen ubit ngon pertandingan cit jeut di kalon di sini bak masa laen thon.

source: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
reference: Keu haba teuntang turnamen ngoen pat dipubloe tiket keu acara tadong polo, neukalon bak Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
hypothesis: Keu haba-haba tentang turnamen dan pat untuk meukat tiket untuk pertandingan polo, kalon Asociación Argentina de Polo.

source: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
reference: Mata peng resmi Falklands nyankeuh Falkland pound (FKP) nyang yumjih dipeugot saban lagee sa Inggris pound (GBP).
hypothesis: Mata péng resmi Falklands nakeuh pound Falkland (FKP) yeng nilai jih dipeuteupat saban ngon nilai saboh pound Britania (GBP).

source: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
reference: Peng jeuet dituka bak saboh beng sagai lam pulo nyan nyang teumpatjih di Stanley blahdeh toko FIC West.
hypothesis: Ureueng jeut geu tuker duit bak bank nyang saboh di pulo-pulo nyan nyang na di Stanley seberang toko FIC West.

source: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
reference: Inggris pounds umumjih diteurimong dumpat lam pulo ngoen dalam keureutu kredit Stanley ngoen Amerika Serikat dollar pih kayem diteurimong.
hypothesis: Pound Britania umum jih akan ditampa di mana mantong di pulo-pulo dan lam kartu kredit Stanley ngen dolar Amerika Serikat cit seureng ditampa.

source: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
reference: Bak pulo-pulo nyang jeuoh mungken keureutu kredit han diteurimong, adakpih Inggris ngoen mata peng Ameurika Seurikat nyang dicok; neupareksa deungon po geuh dilee keu peuteuntee peue cara bayeue nyang diteurimong.
hypothesis: Di pulo-pulo nyang hana meupeukara nyan kartu kredit hana mungken geuteurimong, meskipun mata uang Britania dan Amerika Serikat mungken geuteurimong; periksa deungen pemilik leubeh awai untuk teuteupeue metode pembayaran nyang geuteurimong.

source: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
reference: Nyan karap han mungken keu neutuka mata peng Falklands di luwa pulo, jadi neutuka peng nyan sigohlom neujak dari pulo.
hypothesis: Hana mungken meubah mata uang Falklands di lua pulo, jadi meubah mata uang sigohlom geutinggai pulo-pulo nyan.

source: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
reference: Seubap Montevideo nyan blah tunong dari Equator, hinan musem seuuem watë musem leupie bak Wilayah Utara Bumoe ngoen seubalekjih.
hypothesis: Kareuna Montevideo na di seulatan khatulistiwa, nyan keuh masa musim panas di sinan wate nyan musim dingin di Hemisfer Utara ngen sebaliknya.

source: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
reference: Montevideo nyan lam subtropik; lam buleuen-buleuen musem seuuem, temperature hinan biasajih di ateueh +30°C.
hypothesis: Montevideo na di subtropis; bak buleuen-bulan musim panas, suhu di ateueh +30 °C biasa.

source: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
reference: Musem leupie biasajih leubeh leupie dari nyang ta rasa: temperatures han kayem di yup leupie that, tapi angen ngoen angen juem meugabong nyang peugot nyan leubeh leupie nibak peue nyang dipeuleumah bak termometer.
hypothesis: Musim dingin jeut meunyeusai: suhu jarang di bawah beku, tapi angén ngon kelembapan dipeuget seubagoe rasa leubeh leupie daripada yang dipeugah thermometer.

source: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
reference: Hana musem "ujen" ngoen "tho" nyang ka teuntee: jumlah ujeuen kira-kira teutap saban seupanyang thon.
hypothesis: Hana musim "hujan" dan "gareng" khusus: jumlah ujeuen tinggai kira-kira sama seulama thon.

source: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
reference: Adakpi jai meunatang bak taman nyang ladom i kaloen ureueng, meunatang kleut teutap kleut ngoen bek geu bi eumpeuen atawa jipeukaru.
hypothesis: Meskipun le binatang di taman nyoe biasa untuk melihat manusia, makhluk liar nyan tetap liar dan hana jeuet dipakek atau digubeng.

source: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
reference: Meunurot otoritas taman, dong seukureungjih 100 trah/mete dari cagee ngon seurigala ngon 25trah/mete dari mandum meunatang kleut nyang laen!
hypothesis: Meunurot pihak-pihak taman, jak jiôh leubèh kureueng 100 meter/metre nibak cagée ngon srigala dan 25 meter/metre nibak mandum binatang buih la'én!

source: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
reference: Hana meudaleh kiban seuit meunatang nyan deuh, bison, rusa rayeuk, rusa rayeuk (rusa rayeuk ngoen rusa rayeuk, duwa rusa nyang beda), cagee, ngoen karab mandum meunatang raya rayek jeuet jiseurang.
hypothesis: Padub na jih jih meudafeut, bison, elk, rusa, beruang, dan mandum binatang rayek jeut ji heuntam.

source: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
reference: Tip thon, meuploh jamee luka kareuna ureueng nyan han dijaga ceu nyang pah. Meunatang – meunatang rayeuk, kleut, ngoen jeuet keu paloe, jadi tapeujioh bacut droeteuh keu awaknyan.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb thon, meurön-rön pengunjung keunong luka sabab hana jijaga jarak nyang paih. Beulatang-beulatang nyoe rayeuk, liar, dan berpotensi berbahaya, jadi bri kheueh teumpat keu awaknyan.

source: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
reference: Seubagoe tamah, beu teugoh that bahwasajih bhe galak ih cagee ngoen meunatang kleut nyang laen, jadi taceugah mee atawa magun peunajoh ngoen beu gleh teumpat dom.
hypothesis: Seulaén nibak nyan, ingat kheueh bahwa bau nyan jipeutôi beruang dan beulatang buih nyang laén, jadi peusisapeue kheueh makanan nyang bau nyan dan peujamé kheueh khimah-khimah gata mangat gleh.

source: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
reference: Apia nakeuh ibu kuta Samoa. Kuta nyoe bak pulo Upolu ngoen masyarakat kureueng nibak 40.000.
hypothesis: Apia nakeuh nang nanggroe Samoa. Banda nyan na di pulo Upolu dan na populasi bacut di bawah 40.000 jiwa.

source: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
reference: Apia dipeudong bak thon 1850 ngoen ka jeuet keu ibu kuta reusmi Samoa nibak thon 1959.
hypothesis: Apia geupeudong bak thon 1850an dan ka jeut keu ibu kota resmi Samoa sipanyang thon 1959.

source: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
reference: Peulabohan nyan teumpat angkatan laot hana get thon 1889 wate tujoh kapai ie nibak German, US, ngoen Inggreh geutolak keu peutinggai peulabohan.
hypothesis: Pelabuhan nyan adalah situs dari prang angkatan laut yang terkenal bak thon 1889 wate tujoh kapal dari Jerman, AS, ngen Britania geutulak geutinggai pelabuhan.

source: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
reference: Mandum kapai lham, seulaen saboh kapai penjelajah Inggreh. Karap 200 ureueng Ameurika ngoen Jerman gadoh.
hypothesis: Bandum kapai ka teuneuloh, kecuali saboh kruizer Britania. Kira-kira 200 jiwa Amerika dan Jerman ka gadôh.

source: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
reference: Watë peurjuangan keu meurdeka geuato le gerakan Mau, Meurumpok keu damai bak kuta meuhase teupoh mate Ulee teumanyang Tupua Tamasese Lealofi lll.
hypothesis: Seulama perjuangan kemerdekaan yang dipeurencana le gerakan Mau, saboh rapat seudem di banda nyan mengakibatkan pembunuhan kepala utama Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

source: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
reference: Na le pante di sinan, kareuna Auckland na di antara dua peulabohan. Nyang paleng geutupeue na di lhee area.
hypothesis: Na le pantai, kareuna Auckland na dua pelabuhan. Nyang paleng populer na di lhee wilayah.

source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
reference: Pante North Shore (di distrik North Harbor) na di Samudra Pasifik ngon meuleueng dari Long Bay di utara sampoe Devonport di selatan.
hypothesis: Pantai North Shore (dalam distrik North Harbour) na di Laôt Pasifik dan meujampu dari Long Bay di utara u Devonport di seulatan.

source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
reference: Rap mandum pante meupasi deungon meulango yang aman, ngon seubagian rayek na tumpat mat yang diseudiakan le bak kaye pohutukawa.
hypothesis: Hampir mandum nyan pantai pasir ngon berenang aman, dan le jih na bayangan nyang dipeuteubiet le bak pohutukawa.

source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
reference: Pante Tamaki Drive na di Pelabuhan Waitemata, di bineh kuta glah ateueh Mission Bay ngon St Heliers di Auckland Teungoh.
hypothesis: Pantai Tamaki Drive na di Pelabuhan Waitemata, di pinggiran kota mewah Mission Bay ngen St Heliers di Central Auckland.

source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
reference: Nyoe nakeuh pante keluarga nyang teukadang rame nacit meubagoe toko nyang meubanja di bineh pante. Meulango pih aman.
hypothesis: Nyan na kheueh pantai keluarga nyang kadang-kadang rame ngon le toko nyang meubantu bak panté.

source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
reference: Ie mabok lokal phôn nakeuh 'Number One', Nyoe kon saboh ie mabok kompleks, tapih meusenang ngoen phui. Ie mabok lokal laen jiboh nan "Manta".
hypothesis: Bier lokal utama nakeuh 'Number One', nyan kon saboh bier kompleks, tapi galak dan meupeurasei. Bier lokal laen geuboh nan "Manta".

source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
reference: Na le boh ie anggo Peuranceh nyang jeuet meuteume, tapi ata Seulandia Baro ngoen Australi mungken leubeh mangat.
hypothesis: Na le anggô Perancis yang jeut jijieb, teuma anggur Selandia Baru ngon Australia mungken leubeh get.

source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
reference: Ie kran lokal nakeuh aman keu geujep. Tapi ie lam botol mudah meurumpok miseu gata yo.
hypothesis: Banyu keran lokal nyan aman that untuk jijieb, teuma ie nyang ka dibotol mudah that meurumpok meunyoe awak nyan teumakot.

source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
reference: Keu ureueng Australi, ide kupi 'flat white' nakeuh aseng. Kupi pancong nakeuh 'espresso', cappuccino dipeugot deungon krim di ateuh (kon busa), ngon te dipeugot hana susu.
hypothesis: Keu ureung Australia, gagasan kopi 'putih rata' nyan hana biasa. itam pendek adalah 'espresso', cappuccino teuka di tumpok tinggi deungen krim (han meuapot), dan teh dihidangkan deungen susu.

source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
reference: Coklat suum nakeuh standar bak Belgia. Jus boh kayee meuhai tapi leubeh get.
hypothesis: Coklat panas nyan sesuai standar Belgia. jus buah nyan meuhareuta teuma sangat lagak.

source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
reference: Lee peurjalanan keu terumbu kareung dipeugot tip thon, ngoen ceudera keu salah saboh peunyebab nibak teurumbu kareung jareueng.
hypothesis: Leuh perjalanan keu karang nyan geupeuget sigom thon, dan luka akibat salah saboh sebab nyoe di karang nyan jarang.

source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
reference: Mantong, neu ikot saran nibak pomeurintah, beu tapateh mandum tanda, ngoen takalon peuringatan beuseulamat.
hypothesis: Bah pih meunan, deungoe naseuhat ureuëng-ureuëng nyang meukuasa, taát kheueh ubak mandum tanda-tanda, dan deungoe kheueh deungon gét peuingat-peuingat keu keuseulamatan.

source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
reference: Kotak ubur-ubur hudep toe bineh laot ngoen bineh krueng nibak Oktober keu April bak baroh nibak 1770. Awak nyan kadang-kadang jeuet ta meurumpok dilua watë nyan.
hypothesis: Jellyfish kotak na di deungen pantai ngen deungen estuari krueng dari Oktober sampoe April utara 1770.

source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
reference: Eungkotyee cit na, adakpih awak nyan jareung ipoh manusia. Lee eungkot yee yoe keu manusia ngoen keuneuk meulangu jioh.
hypothesis: Iong-iong hiu memang na, teuma jarang jihina manusia.

source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
reference: Buya ie masen hana sereng udep di laot, teumpat hudep phôn awak nyan nakeuh bak muara krueng baroh nibak Rockhampton.
hypothesis: Krokodil air garam hana aktif udep di laot, habitat utami jih na di estuari krueng utara dari Rockhampton.

source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
reference: Dipeusan diphon dile geujok keutenangan ulee bak jamee awak nyan na teumpat eh watë awak nyan sampoe bak meulangkah.
hypothesis: Meu-reservasi awai geubri keu ureuëng-ureuëng nyang jak nyan aman that até bahwa awak nyan akan na teumpat éh bak watee awak nyan trok bak tujuan jih.

source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
reference: Agen peurjalanan kayem na keuseupakatan deungoen hotel meuteunte, adakpih gata mungken jeuet jipeusan akomodasi laen, lage teumpat meukemah, rot agen peurjalanan.
hypothesis: Agen perjalanan seureng na kesepakatan ngen hotel tertentu, meskipun awak mungken jeut dipeu-reservasi bentuk akomodasi laen, lage lapangan kem, melalui agen perjalanan.

source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
reference: Agen peurjalanan biasajih geupeutaba paket nyang na pajoh bu beungoh, geuato transportasi u/nibak bandara atawa dipeusapat paket peunerbangan ngoen hotel.
hypothesis: Agen perjalanan biasa jih na paket nyang na breakfast, pengaturan transportasi keu/dari bandara atawa bahkan paket penerbangan dan hotel gabungan.

source: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
reference: Awak nyan pih jeuet geutheun peusan keu gata miseu gata peurlee watë keu seumike teuntang geupeutaba atawa peungadaan dokumen laen keu tujuan gata (tamsejih visa).
hypothesis: Awak nyan jeut cit dipeugadeh reservasi keu awak nyan meunyoe awak nyan peureulée watee untuk pike tentang tawaran nyan atawa neucok dokumen laen untuk tujuan awak nyan (misal visa).

source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
reference: Tip peurubahan atawa geulake adakpih seharusjih liwat agen peurjalanan phôn-phôn ngoen hana langsong bak hotel.
hypothesis: Peuneubah atawa peuneugöt pih harus dijak lewat agen perjalanan phon-phon dan kon langsung bak hotel.

source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
reference: Keu padum boh festival, jai nyang idang musik neuk meudom bak teumpat nyan, ngoen jai ureueng geuanggap nyan seubagoe peungalaman nyang peunteng.
hypothesis: Untuk padum boh festival, sebagian rayek ureung nyang jak bak festival musik geupiléh keu geujak peudong khimah bak teumpat nyan, dan le ureung nyang jak nyan geu anggap nyan saboh bagian nyang penting dari pengalaman.

source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
reference: Meusue droeneuh neuk toe dengoen geulagat droeneuh wajeb jak beu phôn nak meutume teumpat dom toe deungoen musik.
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak keuneuk jak tô ngon aksi awak akan teuka awai untuk meuteumé saboh situs kem tô ngon musik.

source: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
reference: Ingat bahpih musik bak panggong phôn ka seulesoe, mungken na festival teutap jimeu’en musik oh malam jula.
hypothesis: Ingat bahwa bah pih musik bak panggung utama mungken ka seuleusoe, mungken na bagian-bagian festival nyang akan meupeumeuen musik sampoe malam.

source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
reference: Padum boh festival na teumpat dom khas keu keuluwarga dengoen aneuk manyak.
hypothesis: Padum boh festival na daerah khusus untuk berkemah untuk keluarga nyang na aneuk miet.

source: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
reference: Meunyo takoh u Baltic Tunong bak musem lupie, pareksa teumpat kabin, seubab neuk lewat eeh nyang peugot gabuek nyang yo that teuh keu ureueng nyang teu peungaroh.
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak peujeumeurang Laôt Baltik Utara bak musém sijeumeulah, periksa lokasi kabin, karena peujeumeurang lewat es meucre su nyang lumpah teumakot keu awak nyang paleng keunong.

source: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
reference: Kapai ie peusiar Saint Petersburg ka itamong bak kuta. Mandumpenumpang kapai ie peusiar han payah syarat visa (acie neutilek syarat).
hypothesis: Cruises Saint Petersburg termasuk watee di banda. Peumpang cruise dipeubeubaih dari syarat visa (cek syarat-syarat).

source: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
reference: Kasino biasajih abeh upaya ngoen abeh watë keu ureueng nyang neuk peuhabeh peng. Tingkap ngoen jeum hana biasajih, ngoen exits susah that ta tume.
hypothesis: Biasa jih, bak kasino-kasino nyan jai that-that ji useuha mangat awak nyan hase jipeuguna leubeh jai watée dan péng jih.

source: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
reference: Awak nyan biasajih na makanan khusus, ie jep ngoen ipeutaba piasan, keu jamee nak nyaman geuh, ngoen keu jaga awak nyan bak premis.
hypothesis: Awaknyan biasa jih na makanan, minuman dan hiburan khusus, untuk dipeuteun tamu dalam suasana hati yang baik, dan peutimang awak nyan di premis.

source: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
reference: Na padum boh tempat ipeutaba ie alkohol bak rumoh nyan. Adakpih, mabok peureuloh meupike, ngoen mandum awak meujudi nyang get peunteng that keu hana mabok.
hypothesis: Na teumpat-teumpat nyang jibri minuman keras di rumoh, teuma meunyoe ureuëng mabök, nyan jipeuteuka bala ateueh ureuëng-ureuëng nyang meujudi, dan mandum ureuëng nyang treble-treble jimeubhej pih jiteupeu padubna peunteng jih beu beu beu-oe.

source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
reference: Soe mantong nyang ek manyang that atawa leubeh nibak gunoeng beuna tingat keu salju, eeh, atawa suhu beuku.
hypothesis: Soe mantong nyang keuneuk jak u lintang tinggi atawa di gunong-gunong harus geupike kemungkinan salju, es, atawa suhu beku.

source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
reference: Bak jalan rayek nyang meusalju, teupehjih haloh nyan droeneuh han jeuet neume moto lagee ateueh aspal soh.
hypothesis: Bak rot nyang meujeut dan meujeut, gesekan hana le dan awak hana jeuet memandu lagee awak na bak aspal.

source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
reference: Nibak trep bade salju, sep deungoen salju mantoeng jeuet peugot droeneuh reubah lam watë siklep mata.
hypothesis: Seulama bada salju, salju yang le untuk taboh jeut taboh dalam watee yang kureueng.

source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
reference: Deuh takalon jiboh ceu le rhot atawa meugule salju atawa kondesasi atawa eh bak tingkap moto.
hypothesis: Visibilitas jeut cit dibatasi le sabab salju rhot atawa jiyueb atawa le sabab kondensasi atawa ais di tingkap kendaraan.

source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
reference: Nibak seulaen nyan, cuwaca sijuek ngoen meusalju nyan hai biasa bak le nanggroe-nanggroe, ngoen keundaraan bak jalan jeuet di jak biasajih hana gangguan lam sithon peunoh.
hypothesis: Di seulanjut jih, kondisi ais dan salju biasa di le nanggroe, dan pengangkutan hana jipiôh seulama thon.

source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
reference: Jak meu safari nyankeuh mungken hai nyang paleng le meukawot wisatawan u Afrika ngoen jeuet keu peunanda keu ramee peungunjong.
hypothesis: Safaris mungken merupakan atraksi wisata paleng rayek di Afrika ngen peunteng bagi le ureung nyang jak.

source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
reference: Istilah safari nyan kayem geu kheun keu rujukan keu jak meu’en meukalon Afrika tutong nyang lagak nyan, teuleubeh lom keu wilayah savanna.
hypothesis: Istilah safari nyang dipakek le ureung ta maksudkan perjalanan darat untuk ta kalon satwa liar Afrika yang meugah, terutama di savanna.

source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
reference: Ladom meunatang, lagee gajah danjeurapah, galak diputoe u moto ngoen na alat nyang standar ka jeuet keu geutanyoe jeuet takalon peumandangan nyang lagak.
hypothesis: Ladom binatang, lage gajah ngon girafa, cenderung mendekati mobil seukeuh dekat dan peralatan standar akan memungkinkan penglihatan yang baik.

source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
reference: Singa, citah ngön rimueng kadang malee ngön gata jeuet neukalon meunatang nyan dum leubeh jeulaih ngön teropong.
hypothesis: Singa, cheetah dan leopard kadang-kadang ceudah dan awak akan deuh leubeh get deungon binocular.

source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
reference: Jak meusafari (kadang dikheun seubagoe "jak lam beulueka", "jak jioh meusafari", atawa jak "ngoen tapak") nyang na roeh jak jioh, jeuet padum jeuem atawa padum uroe.
hypothesis: Safari jalan (jupeugah cit seubagoe "jalan bak uteun", "safari hiking", atawa "meujak") terdiri dari meujak-jak, jeut keu padum-padum jam atawa padum uroe.

source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
reference: Paralimpik nak dimeu’en dari 24 Agustus sampoe 5 September 2021. Ladom lumba nak dimeu’en di ube na dairah-dairah laen nyang na di Jepang.
hypothesis: Paralimpiade akan di la'én nibak 24 Agustus sampoe 5 September 2021. Ladum acara akan di la'én lokasi di Jeupun.

source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
reference: Tokyo nak jeuet keu saboh-sabohjih kuta di Asia nyang ka dipeugot duwa go summer Olimpiade, keuneulheueh dipeugot lumba inan nyankeuh bak thon 1964.
hypothesis: Tokyo akan jeut keu banda Asia yang saboh sagai nyang ka geupeugöt dua Olimpiade musim panas, ka geupeugöt game nyan bak thon 1964.

source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
reference: Meunyo gata neu pesan tiket kapai pho ngoen akomodasi keu 2020 sigohlom watë tunda nyan dibrithee, gata mungken na bak saboh keadaan nyang sosah.
hypothesis: Meunyo awak ka dipeusiap tiket awak dan akomodasi untuk 2020 sigohlom geupeumaklum bahwa awak nyan ka ditunda, awak nyan mungken na situasi nyang payah.

source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
reference: Aturan peubatai nyan na macam-macam, tapi bak akhe buleuen Maret dum aturan nyang peubatai seubap virus corona nyan han dipeupanyang sampoe Juli 2020, watë Olimpiade nyan ka di boh jadwal.
hypothesis: Kebijakan pembatalan bervariasi, tapi bak akhe buleuen Maret sebagian rayek kebijakan pembatalan berbasis virus corona hana meu ek sampoe Juli 2020, wate Olimpiade ka dijadwalkan.

source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
reference: Jeuet ta kira bahwasajih dum yum tiket keu acara nyan antara ¥2,500 ngoen ¥130,000, ngôn nyang biasajih yum tiket nyan ¥7,000.
hypothesis: Diperkirakan bahwa sebagian rayek tiket acara akan meuyuen antara ¥2,500 dan ¥130,000, ngen tiket khas meuyuen sekitar ¥7,000.

source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
reference: Neugeusok bajee nyang juem jeuet peugot nyan tho. Le hotel nyang na geusok ngoen papeun geusok nyang dipeusewa, meuseuki hana meusaboh pih dipuduek lam kama.
hypothesis: Peukayan nyang basah jeuet teupeuseudeh sampoe tho.

source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
reference: Meunyo meusaboh geusok hana disinan, atawa meunyo gata hana biasa bak neusok kawoh gaki nyang meugeusok, nyan jeuet gata cuba ngoenpeutho ok (hairdryer), meunyo na teuseudiya.
hypothesis: Meunyoe beuso hana tersedia, atawa meunyoe awak hana galak memakai kaus beuso, awak jeut neucoba peugeusan rambut, meunyoe na.

source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
reference: Beutegoh mangat ija lipeh bek jeuet seuuem that (nyang jeuet keu seubap baje susot, atawa lam keujadian nyang brat, tutong).
hypothesis: Waspada mangat ija hana jeut keu seu-uem that (yang jeut meuakibat jih kureung, atawa lam kasus nyang luwah, terbakar).

source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
reference: Na le macam cara nyang meubeda keu ta peugleh ie, ladom meuhase keu lawan sipeue-peue peunyaket.
hypothesis: Na cara yang berbeda untuk meucre ie, na yang leubeh efektif terhadap ancaman tertentu.

source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
reference: Lam ladom dairah peuseuuem ie lam seuminet nyan kasep, lam ladom dairah laen peureulee padum-padum minet.
hypothesis: Di padum boh daerah, ie nyang meu-asoe seutoh menit leubeh le, di padum boh daerah, leubeh le watee.

source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
reference: Peusareng nyan na macam-macam lam hai toh nyang leubeh meuhase, ngoen gata beu neupike keunan, oh lheueh nyan gata beu neupike keu neubloe ie lam kaca nyang meutop rapat dari pabrek nyang ka dituri.
hypothesis: Filter bervariasi dalam efektifitas, dan jika awak na masalah, maka awak harus mempertimbangkan untuk meukat ie awak nyan dalam botol yang dipeututup dari saboh perusahaan yang terhormat.

source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
reference: Ureueng nyang jak kunjong nyan mungken meurumpok ngoen binatang hama nyang awak nyan hana dituri lom bak dairah asai awak nyan.
hypothesis: Peujak mungken meurumpok ngon binatang peunyakét nyang hana teumeuek di wilayah asai jih.

source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
reference: Hama jeuet peureuloh peunajoh, peugot gatai, atawa nyang leubeh brat lom peugot wap gatai-gatai, meusipreuek bisa, atawa meukumeun.
hypothesis: Peunyakét-peunyakét jeut jipeurusak makanan, jipeuhase iritasi, atawa lam kasus nyang leubeh parah jipeuhase reaksi alergi, jipeuteubiet racun, atawa jipeutransmisikan infeksi.

source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
reference: Peunyaket nyang meujangket nyan, atawa meunatang nyang meupaloe nyang jeuet peuluka atawa jikapeulut atawa jipoh matee ureueng ngoen jipaksa, biasajih han ditamoeng lam keulompok hama.
hypothesis: Peunyakét peunyakét keudroe, atawa binatang berbahaya nyang jeut luka atawa peumaté manusia deungen paksa, biasa jih hana jeut keu hama.

source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
reference: Beulanja pree nyankeuh ruweung neubloe barang nyang han keunong wase ngoen cukai bak saboh-saboh teumpat.
hypothesis: Beukaih bebas bea adalah kesempatan untuk meukat barang nyang dipeubeubaih dari pajak dan akcis di lokasi tertentu.

source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
reference: Jamee nyang geusaweu u nanggroe deungon wase nyang brat kadang jeuet geukeubah jai peng, phôn that bak dabeuh lagee ie mabok ngôn bakong.
hypothesis: Peujak u nanggroe-nanggroe nyang na pajak rayek kadang jeut ta peuseulamat bacut duit, terutama keu barang-barang lagee minuman keras dan tembakau.

source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
reference: Gareh toe-toe titek Marison ngoen Fairmont jipeuleumah nyang paleng meunantang bak Kuebeu-Jalan Rayeuk Pittsburgh, kayem leupah u dairah uteuen nyang jioh.
hypothesis: Jalur antara Point Marion ngen Fairmont na kondisi peundorong yang paleng sulet bak jalan raya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, seureng lewat di darat bak kayee yang terisolasi.

source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
reference: Meunyoe gata hana kayem neume moto bak jalan gampong, beutathee lam pikeran droeneuh: jalan nyang ubeut, ngoen tikongan tajam jai that.
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak nyan hana biasa awak nyan peumeu-u jalan di gampong, ingat kheueh: tingkat teupat, jalur seudut, dan kurva tajam nyang dominan.
