source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
reference: Ceu bagah diplueng moto nyang dipeudeuh nyan meudum trep that nibak bagoe sigohlomjih ngoen nyang ‘oh lheueh nyan — biasajih 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — ngoen beubrat tapateh keu awakjih nyan leubeh peunteng nibak buet laen.
hypothesis: Limit laju nyang geupeutrang nyan na leubèh kureung nibak lam bagian awai ngon nyang ka lheuh nyan  biasa jih 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h)  ngon patuh teupat keu nyan leubeh peunteng nibak nyang laén.

source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
reference: Adakpih, bingoeng, layanan talipun biyasa hinoe leubeh teuga, dibandeng teumpat laen seupanyang jalan, tamsejih Uteun Rimba Pennsylvania.
hypothesis: Namun, yang menarik, layanan telepon seluler leubeh kuat di sini daripada di seureuta rayek rute laen, miseu jih Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
reference: Peunajoh kueh asai Jerman nyan cukop mangat, ngoen nyang na di Bavaria, ladom meumacam rasa ngoen meumacam bagoe, rap saban lagee jiran awaknyan nyang na i tunoeng, Austria.
hypothesis: Kue Jerman sangat bagus, dan di Bavaria, sangat kaya dan bervariasi, lagee yang di tetangga selatan jih, Austria.

source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
reference: Peunajoh kueh dari boh kayee nyan ka jeuet keu hai nyang lazem, ngon boh apel nyang ditaguen lam peunajoh kueh lam sithon punoeh, ngon boh ceri ngon boh plum na deuh ta kaloen watee musem seuuem.
hypothesis: Kue buah biasa, ngen apel masak jeut keu kue sepanjang thon, ngen ceri dan plum nyang deuh jih selama musim panas.

source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
reference: Jai ureueng Jeurman nyang tot peunajoh kuweh na cit geuboh kacang almond, kacang hazelnut, ngon meubagoe kacang dari bak kayee nyang laen. Peunajoh kuweh nyang dituri nyan kayem mangat dipajoh sira ngon tajep saboh glah ie kupi nyang kreuh.
hypothesis: Leubèh-leubèh bak bak di Jerman na cit meubagoe macam almond, hazelnuts, ngon kacang-kacangan bak kayee la'én.

source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
reference: Meunnyoe gata hawa keu peunajoh kue kreuh nyang mangat rasa, Aci neu ujoe rasa nyang na i dairah nyang dikheun Berliner, Pfannkuchen atawa Krapfen.
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak keuneuk bacut kue ubit tapi kaya, cuba peue nyang tergantung wilayah yang dikhen Berliner, Pfannkuchen atau Krapfen.

source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
reference: Peunajoh kari nyang na keuh saboh teumon bu dari meubagoe oen kayee ngoen dabeuh maguen, geujampu ngoen eungkot sie atawa gulee.
hypothesis: Curry adalah hidangan yeng geupeuget dari ramuan ngen rempah-rempah, seurta boh daging atawa sayuran.

source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
reference: Peunajoh kari nyan na nyang "tho" atawa "meukuwah" nyan dipeuteunte ile dum na jai ie.
hypothesis: Curry jeut "garong" atau "lemot" tergantung bak jumlah cairan.

source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
reference: Dairah nyang meugampong i bahgian India Utara ngoen Pakistan, yogurt nyan lazem diboih lam peunajoh kari, i India Tunong ngoen ladom daerah pantee i bahgian beunua, ie santan lazem di boih lam atra nyan.
hypothesis: Di wilayah pedalaman India Utara ngen Pakistan, yogurt biasa jih dipakek dalam kari; di India Selatan ngen padum boh wilayah pesisir la'én di subkontineng, susu kelapa biasa jih dipakek.

source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
reference: Ngoen 17.000 pulo nyang jeuet tapileh, Peunajoh Indonesia nyan lagee ban tamselan payong nyang khop wilayah nyang luwah that nibak meubagoe macam peunajoh nyang jeuet ta tumee ban saboh nanggroe.
hypothesis: Meunurot 17.000 pulo keu teupiléh, makanan Indonesia adalah istilah umbrella nyang meukalen macam-macam masakan regional nyang na di nanggroe nyan.

source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
reference: Tapih, meunyoe hana ta nilai leubeh jioh, tamselan nyan jeuet keu diboih makna peunajoh nyang troh nibak wilayah bahgian teungoh ngoen timue pulo Jawa sagai.
hypothesis: Teuma, jika dipakek tanpa kualifikasi laen, istilah nyo cenderung teuntang makanan yang asai jih dari bagian pusat dan timu pulau utama Java.

source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
reference: Jinoe dum pat na ban mandum pulo, Peunajoh ureueng Jawa nyan na saboh peukateun nyang deuh nibak cara geuboh dabeuh magun nyang seudang, dabeuh magun nyang paleng jai geu boih le ureueng Jawa na keuh boh kacang tanoh, campli, saka (teuleubeh lom saka boh u Jawa) ngoen meubagoe debeuh magun nyang meubhee harom.
hypothesis: Jinoe ka na di mandum pulo, masakan Jawa na macam-macam hidangan yang biasa dipeurasi, rasa nyang paleng rayek di Jawi adalah kacang, cabe, gula (khusus jih gula kelapa Jawa) dan macam-macam rempah-rempah yang harum.

source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
reference: Sanggrudi nyan na keuh ngoen puduek tapak gaki sidroe ureueng nyang ek guda nyang na di miyup ban duwa blah teumpat duek ateuh guda.
hypothesis: Stirrup adalah dukungan untuk gaki peudagang yang meugantung di boh sisi bak gerob.

source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
reference: Atra duwa nyan jeuet keuh sabagoe peukakah keu peuaman ureueng nyang ek guda tapi jeuet cit keu meupaloe kareuna mungken gaki ureueng nyang ek guda jeuet meusangkot lam atra duwa nyan.
hypothesis: Awak nyan ji peupeunoh stabilitas yang leubeh rayek keu peudagang tapi jeut na masalah keselamatan kareuna potensi gaki peudagang jeut nyangkut lam awak nyan.

source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
reference: Meunyoe sidroe ureueng nyang ek guda nyan rhot dari guda tapih siblah gaki gobnyan mantoeng meusangkot lam sanggrudi, ureueng nyan meubahue ateuh tanoh meunyoe guda teuga diplung. Keu tatheun bahya nyan, ladom cara keu peuaman droe jeuet ta cok seugohlom nyan.
hypothesis: Meunyoe sidroe ureuëng nyang teungoh jiduek ateueh guda jitron nibak ateueh but, teuma gaki jih keunong bak bak bakong, awaknyan jeuet teu-iréng meunyoe guda nyan jiplueng.

source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
reference: Keuphôn, dum ureueng nyang ek guda suwah sok sipatu nyang na tumet ngoen tapak sipatu nyang haloh, ubit bacut.
hypothesis: Nyang phon, le ureueng peudagang dipakek sepatu peudagang nyang na sikil dan sikil nyang gleh, agak sempit.

source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
reference: Lheuhnyan, ladom teumpat duek ateuh guda, teuleubeh lom teumpat duek Inggreh, na kayee keu peuaman nyang jeuet di peu rhot taloe teumpat meusangkot sanggrudi meunyoe meutarek u likot watë rhot ureueng nyang ba guda.
hypothesis: Lheuh nyan, padum-padum saddle, terutama saddle Inggréh, na bar keselamatan yang memungkinkan saboh kulit stirrup rhot dari saddle jika ditarik keurija jika dipeutron keurija.

source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
reference: Jeureulong Cochamó - saboh teumpat ek cot numboi sa nyang na di Chili dituri cit ngoen nan Yosemite di Ameurika Tunong, ngoen meubagoe binteh ngoen kareung dari granit.
hypothesis: Cochamó Valley - tujuan pendakian utama Chili, yang dikenal sebagai Yosemite Amerika Selatan, deungen macam-macam tembok granit rayeuk ngen gunong batée.

source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
reference: Puncak na peumandangan nyang lagak dari ateuh. Ureueng nyang ek cot nyang teuka dari meubagoe bahgian bumoe tiep sabee na geupeuna jalan baro u meubagoe binteh nyang hana akhe nyan.
hypothesis: Sidroe puncak na pandangan nyang meugah dari pucak-pucak. Peunjat dari mandum belahan donya hana putôh-putôh geupeudong rot-rot barô lam kawan potensi beuton nyang hana teujok.

source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
reference: Ulahraga salju u arah troen buket, nyang na keuh ski ngon seluncoe salju, nyan keuh ulahraga nyang jituri nyang na roh meuluncoe u arah miyup i tanoeh nyang meutop ngon salju ngon ski atawa ngon seuluncoe salju nyang meusangkot ngon gaki gata.
hypothesis: Beurangkat salju, yeng termasuk ski ngen snowboarding, adalah olahraga populer yeng melibatkan geser di darat yeng terbenam salju deungen ski atau snowboard yeng dipeutamong bak gaki.

source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
reference: Meu’en ski na keuh keu tujuan utama dari jak meu’en nyang rame ureueng galak, kadang na jiboh nan seubagoe "ureueng nyang udep keu ski", nyang ka geu peugoet reuncana jak watë pre keu meu’en ski bak saboh teumpat meuteunte.
hypothesis: Skiing adalah kegiatan wisata utama deungen le ureung suka, kadang-kadang dikenal seubagoe "ski bums", nyang peugöt liburan seucara lengkap di sekitar ski di saboh lokasi tertentu.

source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
reference: Asai dari ski nyan ka tuha that — gamba nyan jigamba i guha geu peugah nibak ureueng nyang meu’en ski dari jameun ka trep that 5000 BC!
hypothesis: Gagasan ski nyan that tuha  lukisan gua nyang menggambarkan peumeu ski date back to 5000 SM!

source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
reference: Ski u arah tron buket seubagoe saboh ulahraga ka mulai na paleng kureung wateë abad keu-17, ngon wateë 1861 teumpat keu meu’en ski nyang keu-phôn that i buka le ureueng Norwegia di Australia.
hypothesis: Ski downhill seubagai olahraga meuwoe bak abad keu-17, ngen bak thon 1861 klub ski rekreasi phon dipeubuka le Norwegia di Australia.

source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
reference: Meuba tah raya sira meu’en ski: Buet nyoe jeuet cit dikheun ski u alam luwa, ski sira jak jioh atawa ski sira ek gunong.
hypothesis: Backpacking ngon ski: Aktifitas nyo cit geukheun backcountry ski, tour ski atawa hiking ski.

source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
reference: Nyoe meusangkot tapih hana roeh ngôn jak jioh ski aleh alpine atawa jak ek gunong, nyang keuneuleuh nyoe ipubuet i wilayah tanoh nyang meureuleueng ngoen peureulee keu alat ski ngoen sipatu nyang kreuh.
hypothesis: Jih meuhubong ngen tapi biasa jih hana melibatkan wisata ski gaya alpine atau pendakian gunong, yang terakhir di la'én nyang teujak di darat curam dan merlukeun skis dan sepatu yang le that kaku.

source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
reference: Neupikee mantoeng rauh jak ski nyang saban cit lagee jalan jak ek gunong.
hypothesis: Pike rot ski lagee rot hiking nyang saban.

source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
reference: Lam watë nyang get gata keuneuk troh u teumpat nyang leubeh jioh lom nibak neujak ngoen tapak – tapi jareung that gata keuneuk troh bagah lagee tajak ngoen ski i alam luwa ngoen hana tah geuhon sajan watë i jalan nyang biyasa.
hypothesis: Lam kondisi yang get awak jeut ta peutaloe jarak nyang leubeh luwah daripada geujak  tapi sangat jarang awak jeut ta peuget kecepatan ski lintas daerah tanpa tasek rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug rug

source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
reference: Eropa nakeuh saboh benua nyang relatif ubeut teutapi deungoen le nanggroe meurdehka. Jimiyub keadaan normal, meujak-jak rhot padum boh nanggroe wajeb liwat aplikasi visa ngoen geupareksa paspor padum go.
hypothesis: Eropa nakeuh saboh benua nyang relatif ubit tapi na le nanggroe nyang independen. Lam keadaan biasa, jak liwat le nanggroe nyang na meupadub boh nyan na kheueh meupeutuah keu peuseuleusoe aplikasi visa dan kontrol paspor le that kali.

source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
reference: Wilayah Schengen, adak pih, keureuja karab lage saboh nanggroe lam geuhormati nyoe.
hypothesis: Namun zona Schengen, bekerja lagee saboh nanggroe lam hal nyo.

source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
reference: Watë gata tinggai lam wilayah nyoe, gata biasajih jeuet liwat peurbatasan hana jak rhot poh peupareksa paspor dile.
hypothesis: Seulama awak tinggai di zona nyoe, awak jeut umum jih meulinteng perbatasan tanpa geujak liwat pos pemeriksaan paspor lom.

source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
reference: Lage nyan cit, na poe visa Schengen, gata hana peurlee ngui visa keu maseng-maseng nanggroe anggota Schengen, jeuet keubah watë, peng ngoen beureukas.
hypothesis: Meunan cit, deungen na visa Schengen, awak nyan hana peureulée untuk meulakée visa keu masing-masing negara anggota Schengen secara terpisah, ngon nyan neumeunghemat wate, péng dan dokumen.

source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
reference: Hana difinisi umum keu bagoe dabeuh-dabeuh nyang jipeugoet dikheun keu dabeuh antik. Ladom agen pajak geuteutapkan dabeuh nyang sep brat trep ka dari 100 thon seubagoe dabeuh antik.
hypothesis: Hana definisi universal yeng meutumeng barang-barang nyang di peuget nakeuh barang-barang kuno. Ladum agensi pajak meutumeng barang-barang nyang leubeh tuha dari 100 thon seubagoe barang kuno.

source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
reference: Difinisi nyan nakeuh meubagoe macam meuhubong ngôn wilayah, nibak ceu umu mungken paneuk that i teumpat – teumpat lage Ameurika Tunong dari i Ierupa.
hypothesis: Definisi na variasi geografis, di teumpat batas umure jeut kureung di tempat lage Amerika Utara daripada di Eropa.

source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
reference: Buet jaroe jeuet jikheun seubagoe dabeuh antik, adakpi atranyan leubeh ban na nibak peuneugot ureueng ramee nyang sama hi.
hypothesis: Produk kerajinan jeut didefinisikan seubagai barang antik, meskipun jih leubeh muda daripada barang-barang produksi massal yang serupa.

source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
reference: Peularha rusa nyan keuh cara mita raseuki i seulingka ureueng Sámi ngoen budaya seulingka bloe meubloe nyankeuh cara mita raseuki peunteng sit keu ureueng ramee ngoen pangkat laen.
hypothesis: Peuneuduëk reindeer nakeuh saboh sumber udeb nyang peunteng di kalangan Sami ngen budaya nyang jikeulileng perdagangan nyan peunteng cit keu le ureung nyang na profesi laen.

source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
reference: Bahpih seucara tradisional, adakpi, hana mandum ureueng Sámi rhoh lam peularha rusa lam jumlah nyang jai, tapih udep ngoen geukeumawe, jak lam uteun ngoen seujeunehjih, na rusa na ladom nyang jai meunatang teumarek.
hypothesis: Bahkan secara tradisional, meskipun, hana mandum Sami ka terlibat dalam pertanian rentik skala rayek, tetapi udep dari neungôn, neungôn dan lagee nyan, le jih rentik seubagoe binatang draf.

source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
reference: Uroe nyoe jai ureueng Sámi keureuja bak bloe peubloe nyang moderen. Ureueng jak tamasya nyankeuh wase nyang peuteng i Sámi.
hypothesis: Jinoe le ureung Sami bekerja lam profesi modern. Pariwisata nakeuh saboh pendapatan rayek di Sápmi, daerah Sami.

source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
reference: Bahpih nyan jai jiboh, keu phôn that bak kalangan non-Romani, kata "gipsi" kayem jianggap teupeh kareuna meusapatjih ngoen nilai hana get ngoen pandangan nyang hana trang keu awak Romani.
hypothesis: Meskipun jih dipakek le, terutama di antara non-Romani, kata "Gypsy" seureng dianggap peukeurasan kareuna asosiasi jih deungen stereotip negatif ngen persepsi yang hana akurat tentang ureung Roma.

source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
reference: Meunyoe nanggroe nyang droeneuh jak saweu tundok keu haba peuingat bak rauh, asuransi keusihatan peurjalanan droeneuh mungken teupeungaroh bak asuransi peubateu peurjalanan droeneuh.
hypothesis: Meunyoe nanggroe nyang awak akan jak u jeut keu bahan nasehat perjalanan, asuransi kesehatan awak jak atawa asuransi pembatalan awak nyan mungken keunong.

source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
reference: Droeneuh mungken jeuet sit neuteumanyoeng deungoen saran pomeurintah selaen droe teuh, tapih saranjih nyankeuh nyang jirancang keu ureueng gampongjih.
hypothesis: Awak pih mungken neutem jak mita naseuhat nibak peumeurintah nyang laén nibak awak awak awak nyan, teuma naseuhat awak nyan ka teupeuteuntée keu waréh kawöm awak nyan.

source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
reference: Lage saboh miseu, awak nanggroe Ameurika i timu teungoeh mungken geuhadapi keuadaan nyang meubeda nibak ureueng Eropa ngoen ureueng Arab.
hypothesis: Sebagai saboh contoh, warganegara Amerika di Timur Tengah mungken meupeudeh situasi yang berbeda dari Eropa atau Arab.

source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
reference: Nasihat nakeuh saboh ceurita tuet bak keuadaan politek i saboh nanggroe.
hypothesis: Peunaseuhat nyan cuma saboh ringkasan singkat tentang situasi politik di saboh nanggroe.

source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
reference: Tampilan nyang jiseudiya kayem sigoe ble, umum ngoen jipeupah jeuet keu haba nyang leubeh trang jiseudiya bak teumpat laen.
hypothesis: Pandangan nyang di peubloe seureng yeng hana umum, umum ngen yeng dipermudah le seucara teupat ngen informasi yeng lubeh rinci yeng na di lua.

source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
reference: Cuwaca brok nyankeuh istilah umum keu tip fenomena cuwaca nyang meupaloe nyang teubit sabap reulhoh, keubit peugabuk dum ureueng, atawa gadoh nyawoeng ureueng.
hypothesis: Cuaca parah adalah istilah umum untuk fenomena cuaca berbahaya yeng berpotensi meuakibat keu kerusakan, gangguan sosial yang serius, atau kehilangan nyawa manusia.

source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
reference: Cuwaca hana get keu neukjeuet dumpat lam dônya, ngoen meubagoe jeuneh, nyan jeuet meusangkot bak geografi, topografi, ngoen keuadaan atmosfir.
hypothesis: Cuaca parah jeut terjadi di pat mantong di donya, dan na macam-macam jih, yeng jeut meugantung bak geografi, topografi, ngen kondisi atmosfer.

source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
reference: Angen bade, ujeun eh, ujeun raya, ngoen tutoeng uteun sabap cuwaca hana get, lage bade geulanteu, angen topan, angen puteng beuliyong, ngoen angen meuputa.
hypothesis: Angén raya, ujeuen es, ujeuen raya, dan kebakaran hutan adalah bentuk dan akibat cuaca yang parah, lage badai, tornado, air beukah, dan badai.

source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
reference: Fenomena cuwaca hana get ngoen teumpat teumasok bade salju, bade-bade salju, bade eh, ngoen bade abee.
hypothesis: Fenomena cuaca regional ngen musiman yeng parah termasuk badai salju, badai salju, badai es, ngen badai debu.

source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
reference: Ureueng jak tamasya sep brat geubi nasihat beu teugoh that meuresiko cuwaca hana get nyang meupeungaroh teumpat awak nyan kareuna jeuet keu mepeungaroh dumpue peurjalanan.
hypothesis: Peujak-peujak teuringat that untuk sadar akan resiko cuaca parah yeng mempengaruhi wilayah awak nyan kareuna awak nyan jeut meupeungaroh akan rencana perjalanan.

source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
reference: Sibeurangkasoe nyang keuneuk saweu u nanggroe nyang ka jianggap teumpat meuprang suwah meutume peulatihan profisional.
hypothesis: Soe mantong nyang ka jikeuneuk jak u nanggroe nyang jeut jianggap wilayah prang, harus meurunoe keu peunaseuhat.

source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
reference: Seutot bak internet keu 'Meurunoe bak teumpat nyang na musoh' mungken jibi alamat peurusahaan lam wilayah droe.
hypothesis: Seulaen pencarian internet untuk 'kursus lingkungan nyang hana ramah' mungken akan geubri alamat saboh perusahaan lokal.

source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
reference: Jak meurunoe biasajih neuk teumasok ban mandum peukara nyang jipeugah hinoe ngoen abeh mandum, biasajih ngoen peungalaman pubuet langsong.
hypothesis: Kursus biasanya akan mencakup mandum isu yang dibahas di sini secara detail, biasa jih dengan pengalaman praktis.

source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
reference: Jak meurunoe biasajih teumasok 2-5 uroe ngoen roh meu’en droe, jai soe tuloeng bak phôn ngoen meurunoe seunjata.
hypothesis: Kursus biasanya akan dari 2-5 uroe dan akan melibatkan peran, le bantuan pertama dan kadang-kadang pelatihan senjata.

source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
reference: Buku ngoen majalah nyang meusangkot ngoen udep uteuen beulantara nyankeuh hai ladem, tapi publikasi nyang meusangkot bacut ngoen wilayah prang.
hypothesis: Kitab ngon majalah nyang meuhubongan ngen kelangsungan hidup di padang pasi biasa, teuma publikasi nyang meuhubongan ngen zona prang bacut.

source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
reference: Ureueng tamasya nyang niet geuneuk operasi meunale iluwa nanggroe suwah geu peuteunte bahwasajih awaknyan jiba beureukah nyang geuakui keu peurjalanan woe.
hypothesis: Ureueng-ureueng nyang teungoh peugöt operasi peugöt agam di lua nanggroe harus meurasa bahwa awak nyan jiba dokumen nyang sah keu uengkot pulang.

source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
reference: Geutem pomeurentah peutubiet paspor ngoen jeuneh keulamin nynag hana geuseubot (X) atawa beureukah jipeubaro nak saban ngoen nan nyang galak geuh ngoen meubagoe jeuneh keulamin.
hypothesis: Keugalian peumeurintah untuk meujok paspor nyang hana geu kheun gender (X) atawa dokumen nyang diupdet keu meujubah nama dan gender nyang jikeuneuk.

source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
reference: Geutem poemeurentah luwa keu geupeuyum buereukah-beureukah nyan sit sep meumacam bagoe.
hypothesis: Keutateuan pemerintah asing untuk meukuasa dokumen nyoe saban that bervariasi.

source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
reference: Taseutoet bak pos peumeuriksaan keuamanan pih meutamah brat gabuek bak lheuh 11 September, masa 2001.
hypothesis: Peukapatan di pos pemeriksaan keamanan ka le that meukaru dalam era lheh 11 September 2001.

source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
reference: Ureueng transgender Lheuh-Operasi jeuet han jiharap keu leupah peumindai deungoen privasi ngoen matabat awaknyan keunong.
hypothesis: Ureuëng transgender nyang hana meuoperasi hana jeuet jipreh-preh keu geujak liwat scanner deungon privasi dan martabat jih hana rusak.

source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
reference: Ie meuguloeng nyankeuh riyeuk meuhambo i bineh pasi, kayem i ateuh bate kareung atawa ngoen seujeunehjih.
hypothesis: Corrients Rip adalah aliran nyang geuwoe dari ombak nyang dipeubeukah dari pantai, seureng di karang atau serupa.

source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
reference: Kareuna topologi imiyup ie, ilee ie meuriwang le bak padit boh bahgian nyang lhok, ngoen ilee ie nyang sep bagah u ie nyang lhok mungken asai phôn jisinan.
hypothesis: Kareuna topologi bawah air aliran woe nyan terkonsentrasi bak padim boh bagian nyang leubeh lhok, dan aliran laju u dalam ie jeut terbentuk di sinan.

source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
reference: Dum ureueng meuninggai kareuna hek meulangue geutheun ie, nyang mungken mustahe.
hypothesis: Leubeh le kematian terjadi akibat leumoh cuba meulangue bak bak bak bak bak, yang mungken hana mungken.

source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
reference: Lam sigra lheuh tatubiet nibak ie, tameulangue kop payah dari biasajih.
hypothesis: Seugolom awak nyan ka teubiet dari arus, meulambong lom hana leubeh payah nibak biasa.

source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
reference: Ci neujak u arah bak saboh teumpat dipat gata han le roeh lam nyan atawa, meugantong bak keuahlian gata ngoen pue gata peuratie, gata mungken neupreh jituloeng.
hypothesis: Cuba tujuan bak teumpat nyang hana keunong lom atawa, tergantung bak keahlian gata dan peu kheueh awak nyan ka teutilek, mungken awak nyan keuneuk preh seulamat.

source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
reference: Teukeujot aleuh geutamong teuma leubeh bagah teujadi dari teukeujot budaya (hana had buleun phon), leubeh trep ngoh leubeh brat.
hypothesis: Guncang lom teuka leubeh awai daripada guncang budaya (na bacut fase buleun madu), treb, ngen jeut leubeh parah.

source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
reference: Awak galak jak nyang na watee mangat geupeusaban droegeuh ngon adat baro meujan-jan payah that roh geupeusaban droe ngon budaya droegeuh.
hypothesis: Wisatawan nyang mudah meuadaptasi keu budaya baroe kadang-kadang payah that meuadaptasi lom keu budaya asli jih.

source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
reference: Watee woe u rumoh lheuh geuduek iluwa nanggroe, droe neuh ka neu peubiasa droe ngon adat baro ngon gadoh adat droe neuh dari nanggroe asai.
hypothesis: Watée neuwoe u rumoh óh lheueh tinggai di lua nanggroe, awak ka meuadaptasi ngon budaya baroe dan ka gadôh padum boh kebiasaan awak nibak budaya rumoh awak.

source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
reference: Watee dron neuh phon trok u luwa nanggroe, ureueng mungken saba ngon meuphom, awaknyan jitupeue awak galak jak bak nanggroe baro peureule peusaban droe.
hypothesis: Watée awak nyan jak u nanggroe laén, awak nyan mungken seudeh dan muphom, sabab awak nyan jiteupeu bahwa awak nyang jak u nanggroe nyang barô nyan peureulée keu meuadaptasi.

source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
reference: Ureueng mungken hana geutupeue bahwa saba ngon meuphom nyan peureulee keu awak galak jak-jak nyang woe u rumoh.
hypothesis: Ureuëng-ureuëng hana mungken jipike bahwa sabar dan peungeurtian pih diperlukan keu ureuëng-ureuëng nyang teungoh uengkot u rumoh.

source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
reference: Su meulagu ngoen cahya piramida nyankeuh saboh hai nyang sep lagak bak teumpat nyan keu aneuk miet.
hypothesis: Pamerakan suara dan cahaya piramida nakeuh salah saboh hal nyang paleng menarik di daerah nyoe keu aneuk miet.

source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
reference: Gata jeut taeu piramida nyan lam seupôt ngön lam seungap sigohlom piasan nyan dipuphôn.
hypothesis: Neungieng piramida lam seupôt dan neungieng awaknyan lam su nyang seungab sigohlom acara dimulai.

source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
reference: Biasajih gata sabèe tadeungoe su ureueng meukunjông ngön ureueng meukat. Calitra su ngön calitra cahya nyan lagèe saboh buku calitra.
hypothesis: Biasa awak nyoe sabe na suara wisatawan dan vendor. Cerita suara dan cahaya nyan lagee buku cerita.

source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
reference: Sphinx nyan dipeujeut keu layeu di likôt ngön keu nyang peugah saboh calitra nyang panyang.
hypothesis: Sphinx dipeuduek seubagai latar belakang dan narator saboh kisah yang panyang.

source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
reference: Gamba-gamba dipeudeuh bak piramida nyan, ngön piramida-piramida laén dipeuhu cahya.
hypothesis: Adegan jih ditampilkan bak piramida ngen piramida yeng berbeda dipeutrang.

source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
reference: Pulo Shetland Seulatan, nyang diteumèe bak thôn 1819, diakui lé padum boh nanggroe, pulo nyan na paléng lë markah teuntra, deungön nam blah nyang manteng aktif lam thôn 2020.
hypothesis: Kepulauan Shetland Selatan, nyang teutap bak thon 1819, diklaim le le bansa ngen na basis nyang paleng le, na nam blaih aktif bak thon 2020.

source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
reference: Pulo nyan meuleueng 120 km u baroh di ujông. Nyang paléng rayek nakeuh Pulo King George deungön pemukiman Villa Las Estrellas.
hypothesis: Nusantara nyoe na 120 km di utara Semenanjung. nyang paleng rayek nakeuh Pulo Raja George ngon teumpat tinggai Villa Las Estrellas.

source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
reference: Pulo nyang laén nakeuh Pulo Livingston, ngön pulo Deception nyang ile kaldera dari gunong meuapui yang manteng aktif, atranyan peugot peulabohan deuh lagak.
hypothesis: Laen jih na termasuk Pulo Livingston, ngen Deception di sinan caldera nyang ka keunong banjir dari saboh gunung berapi yang mantong aktif meujok pelabuhan alam yang spektakuler.

source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
reference: Ellsworth Land nakeuh dairah blah tunong ujông tanjong, diceue lé Laôt Bellingshausen.
hypothesis: Tanoh Ellsworth nakeuh wilayah di seulatan Semenanjung, nyang diwatesan le Laôt Bellingshausen.

source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
reference: Gunong-gunong bak wilayah tanjong disinoe meusapat jeut keu tanoh manyang, ‘oh lheueh nyan meusapat lom jeut keu 360 km rante gunong Ellsworth, diplah lé Glacier Minnesota.
hypothesis: Gunong-gunong di Semenanjung nyoe meujampu u dalam dataran tinggi, laju meu-eumpeuget lom untuk meupeuget rantai 360 km gunong-gunong Ellsworth, dipeukab le gletser Minnesota.

source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
reference: Dairah blah baroh atawa Sentinel Range na gunong nyang paléng manyang di Antartika, nanjih Vinson Massif, manyang puncakjih Gunong Vinson 4892 m.
hypothesis: Bagian utara atawa Sentinel Range na gunong tertinggi Antartika, Massif Vinson, puncak jih di 4892 m Mount Vinson.

source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
reference: Bak teumpat nyang jioh, hana jangkauan télépon, saboh télépon sateulit mungkén jeut keu pilehan gata.
hypothesis: Di teumpat-teumpat nyang jiôh, hana nyang na peunghyang handphone, saboh telepon satelit mungken seuboh pilihan awak.

source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
reference: Saboh télépon sateulit umumjih kon saboh geulantoe keu télépon seluler, gata suah na i luwa deungön pandangan nyang trang mangat jeut peugot saboh panggelan télépon.
hypothesis: Telepon satelit hana umum jih ji ganti ponsel, kareuna awak nyan harus di luwa ngon garis pandang yang jelas keu satelit untuk meuget panggilan telepon.

source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
reference: Layanan nyoe leubéh kayem dingui lé meulayeu, teumasok kapai peusiar, ngön ekspedisi nyang peurlèe data dari jioh ngön peurlèe su.
hypothesis: Layanan nyo seureng dipakek le kapal, termasuk peurahô hiburan, meunan cit ekspedisi nyang na data jarak jauh dan kebutuhan suara.

source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
reference: Layanan télépon lokal gata seharohjih jeut dijok haba bah meusambông keu layanan nyoe.
hypothesis: Penyedia layanan telepon lokal awak nyan harus jeut geubri informasi leubeh le tentang hubungong ngen layanan nyoe.

source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
reference: Hai nyang ka mulai di turi sabagoe saboh pilihan bagi nyang meu rencana dalam sithôn nakeuh jak travel sira jak meuruno.
hypothesis: Pilihan yang semakin populer bagi ureung nyang peugöt thon gap adalah untuk bereja ngen meurunoe.

source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
reference: Nyoe leubéh lom di turi lé awak nyang barô tamat sikula, jeuet keu urueng nyan untuk cok watèe keu sithôn sigolom jak tameng universitas, tanpa harus peutinggai peundidekan.
hypothesis: Nyo terutama populer di kalangan yang bereh dari sekolah, yang memungkinkan awak nyan untuk mengambil satu tahun sebelum universitas, tanpa mengkompromikan pendidikan awak nyan.

source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
reference: Dalam le kasus, tadaftar untuk sithôn jak sikula u luwa naggroe jeuet meutamah kesempatan bagi droeteuh untuk tapinah sikula nyang leubéh hayeu lom di nanggroe droe.
hypothesis: Lam padum boh kasus, meupeunteuk bak kursus gap-year di lua nanggroe jeut teumeutingkat peluang awak keu pindah keu pendidikan tinggi di nanggroe awak.

source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
reference: Biasajih akan na biaya peundidekan untuk ta daftar program-program peundidekan nyan.
hypothesis: Biasa jih akan na biaya kuliah untuk meumeu enrekrut lam program pendidikan nyo.

source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
reference: Finlandia nakeuh tujuan meupeuraho yang lagak. “Nanggroe Siribee Dano” cit na meuribee pulo, di dano ngon di kepulauan peusise.
hypothesis: Finlandia nakeuh tujuan peurahô nyang rayek. "Negara meuribée danau" na cit meuribée pulo, lam danau dan di pulo-pulo pesisir.

source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
reference: Di pulo-pulo ngon dano droen hana peurele kapai peusiar.
hypothesis: Di pulo-pulo dan danau awak nyan hana peureulèë awak nyan na peuneuôt.

source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
reference: Bah pih kepulauan peusiser ngon danau nyang paleng rayek memang cukop rayek keu kapai peusiar toh mantong, peuraho nyang leubeh ubit atawa bahkan kayak peureulee peungalaman yang meubeda.
hypothesis: Meskipun kepulauan pesisir dan danau rayek nyan memang rayeuk that untuk peurahô, peurahô ubit atawa bahkan kayak na pengalaman yang berbeda.

source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
reference: Meupeuraho nakeuh hobi nasional di Finlandia, deungon saboh peuraho keu tiep tujoh atau lapan ureueng.
hypothesis: Peutap nakeuh saboh hobi nasional di Finlandia, na saboh peutap keu tujoh atawa lapan droe.

source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
reference: Nyoe cocok deungon Norwegia, Swedia ngon Selandia Baro, teutapi sibalekjih cukop unik (miseujih di Belanda angka jih sa bandeng peut ploh).
hypothesis: Nyo dipeuramai le Norwégia, Swedia ngen Selandia Baru, tapi laen jih sangat unik (misal di Belanda angka nyan adalah satu sampai peuet ploh).

source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
reference: Le dari kapai-kapai pesiar mewah Baltic Cruises dipiyoh dalam watèe nyang trep di St. Petersburg, Russia.
hypothesis: Leuh krue Baltic nyang berbeda na peunteng nyang panyang di St. Petersburg, Rusia.

source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
reference: Nyoe berarti droeneuh jeuet neukunjông kuta nyang meusejarah lam padup uroe sira neuwo ngön neueh dalam kapai watèe malam.
hypothesis: Nyoe teungui awak jeut ta kunjungi kota bersejarah nyan selama seulanjut jih seulama awak nyan jiwoe dan moe bak kapai bak malam.

source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
reference: Meunyoe droeneuh neu tingoh u darat deungön paket piknik dari kapai droeneuh hana peureulèe lé keu visa nyang laén (mulai thôn 2009).
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak nyan jak bak darat bak tujuan uengkot awak nyan hana awak nyan peureulée visa nyang terpisah (sampoe thon 2009).

source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
reference: Ladom kapai pesiar na dipeuroh Berlin, German dalam brosur-brosur. Lage nyang deuh neu kalen dari map nyang na di ateuh Berlin nyan hana toe meubacut pih deungön laôt ngön jak meukeunjong u kutanyan hana roeh dalam biaya sewa kapai pesiar.
hypothesis: Padum-padum boh kruiz na di Berlin, Jerman lam brosur-brosur. Lagee awak jeut kalon bak peta di ateueh Berlin hana di teumpat-teumpat nyang rab ngon laot dan kunjungan u banda nyan hana termasuk lam harga kruiz nyan.

source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
reference: Jak travel deungön kapai phe jeuet keu saboh pengalaman nyang geu takot lé ureueng dari mandum umu ngön kalangan, leubéh khusus lom bagi ureueng nyang sigohlomjih han tom geu jak deungön kapai phe atawa nyang na pengalaman akan keujadian nyang geu peugot ureueng nyan ye.
hypothesis: Meujak u pasai jeut keu pengalaman nyang menakutkan keu ureung dari mandum umureung dan latar belakang, terutama meunyoe awak nyan hana pernah terbang sigohlom nyan atawa ka na pengalaman traumatis.

source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
reference: Nyan nakeuh saboh hai nyang hana peureulèe malèe teuh, nyan hana meubeda deungön hai-hai nyang biasa di takot lé ureueng ngön nyang di peujioh nyang ramé ureueng rasa.
hypothesis: Hana sapeue pih nyang jeuet keu malée: hana meubeda ngon peurasaan teumakot dan hana galak keu hai-hai nyang laén nyang le that ureuëng.

source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
reference: Keu ladom ureueng, peumahaman akan hai tentang kiban cara kapai phe nyan di phe ngön peue nyang roh watèe kapai nyan di phe mungkén akan jeut keu saboh cara ureueng nyan geu lawan ye nyang meu dasar bak hai nyang hana ta teupue ngön nyang hanjeut ta kendali.
hypothesis: Keu na nyang, meuphom bacut tentang cara kerja pesawat dan peue nyang teujadi bak watee awak teungoh meulayeue mungken membantu untuk jipeutaloe takot nyang meudasai bak hana meuteupeue atawa hana hase kontrol.

source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
reference: Perusahaan-perusahaan intat barang nyan got that dibayeue untuk intat barang beu bagah. Kayem that, watèe nyan utama that untuk dokumen bisnis, barang meukat atawa bahan-bahan nyang peureulèe keu peuget barang.
hypothesis: Perusahaan kurir dibayar that untuk peulheueh barang-barang sigra.

source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
reference: Keu ladom arah jak, perusahaan nyang leubéh rayek na kapai phe khusus atra awak nyan, tapi keu ladom arah jak nyang laén ngön ladom peurusahaan nyang ubeut na masalah disinan.
hypothesis: Bak padum boh rute, perusahaan rayek na pesawat awak nyan keudroe, tapi untuk rute laen dan perusahaan rayek na masalah.

source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
reference: Meunyoe awak nyan di kirem barang deungön kapai phe, bak ladom arah jak mungkén trok sampoe meu uroe-uroe keu jipeutreun barang ngön buet adat.
hypothesis: Meunyoe barang-barang nyan ji kirém deungon cara peutahanan udara, bak na rot-rot mungken na meupadub uroe keu ji peutamong dan ji peutahan barang-barang nyan.

source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
reference: Saboh-saboh jih cara bah jeut leubéh bagah bak takirem nyankeuh deungön di cek barang. Aturan maskapai han jeut di kirem barang lé awak nyan meunyoe hana peunumpang, nyan keuh nyan saat droenueh neu tamong.
hypothesis: Cara jih cuma untuk peuseutoi nyan leubeh sigra adalah keu peuturi jih seubagai bagasi nyang ka teutarek. peraturan pawai hana geupeu idhin keu awaknyan untuk peuturi bagasi tanpa penumpang, nyan keuh teumpat awak jak.

source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
reference: Cara nyang jeulah beujeut teureubang di glah phon atawa glah bisnis nyan keuh beujai tapeutubit peng keu hak istimewa nyan (atawa, leubeh get lom talakee peurusahaan droeneuh peubut keu gata).
hypothesis: Cara yang jelas untuk terbang dalam kelas phon atawa bisnis adalah untuk meulah saboh wad padet péng untuk hak istimewa nyan (atau, leubeh get lom, minta perusahaan awak untuk meulah jih keu awak).

source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
reference: Tapi, nyoe hana murah : lagee lam sigra, droeneuh jeuet neuharap bayeu peuet go lipat dari yum ekonomi biasajih keu glah bisnis, ngon siblah go u glah phon.
hypothesis: Namun, nyoe hana meuhase: seubagai aturan kasar, awak jeut taharap untuk meutanggong biaya ekonomi biasa sampoe peuet kali lipat untuk bisnis, dan sebelas kali lipat untuk kelas phon!

source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
reference: Seucara umum jih, hana meuguna tamita kureueng yum bangku glah bisnis atawa glah phon nibak penerbangan lansong poe dari A u B.
hypothesis: Secara umum, hana guna jih untuk mita diskon untuk bisnis atawa kursi kelas awai bak penerbangan langsung dari A keu B.

source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
reference: Maskapai kapai teureubang get that itupeue nyang bahwa na sekelompok khusus dari peunumpang kapai nyang tem bayeu meuhai keu meuteumee hak istemewa keu meurumpok teumpat duek nyang bagah ngon mangat, deungon yum nyang sesuai.
hypothesis: Airlines jiteupeu that na saboh kelompok utô awak nyang rila jibayeue dolar untuk hak istimewa untuk jak bak teumpat nyang rapih dan nyaman, dan geungui biaya sisuai.

source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
reference: Ibukuta Moldova nakeuh Chisinau. Basa daerahjih nyan keuh Rumania. Tapi jai nyang peugahba basa Rusia.
hypothesis: Nang nanggroe Moldova nakeuh Chişinău. Bahsa lokal nakeuh Rumania, teutapi Rusia that that that dipakek.

source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
reference: Moldova nyan keuh saboh reupublik multi-etnis nyang ka sep jra dari komplik etnis.
hypothesis: Moldova nakeuh republik multi-etnis nyang ka meudeurita dari konflik etnis.

source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
reference: Nibak thôn 1994, komplik nyoe keuh na peumbeuntukan reupublik Transnistria nyang i proklamirkan keudroejih hideh di Moldova bahgian timu, ka na peumeuritahan droe ngön peng droe tapi hana jiakuai lé nangroe-nanggroe yang na lam PBB.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1994, konflik nyoe meuakibat keu peuneugöt Republik Transnistria yang geukheun droe di Moldova timu, yeng na peumeurintah dan mata uang jih keudroe teutapi hana diakui le negara anggota PBB.

source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
reference: Sinambong ekonomi ka geupeugot lom antara dua boh bahgian Moldova adak pih keuseupakatan hana meuhasé.
hypothesis: Hubungan ekonomi ka geupeudong lom antara dua bagian Moldova nyoë meskipun gagal dalam negosiasi politik.

source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
reference: Pang ule agama di Moldova nyan keuh agama kristen ortodoks.
hypothesis: Agama utama di Moldova nakeuh Kristen Ortodoks.

source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
reference: Izmir nakeuh kuta keu lhèe paléng rayek di Turki deungön mandum ureueng 3,7 juta, peulabuhan keudua paléng rayek lheuh Instanbul ngön pusat trasnportasi nyang get.
hypothesis: Izmir nakeuh banda nyang keu lhee rayek di Turki ngon populasi sekitar 3,7 juta, pelabuhan nyang keudua rayek lheuh Istanbul, ngon hub transportasi nyang that jroh.

source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
reference: Masa dilèe Smyrna kuta jameun, jinoe ka moderen, ka maju, kajeut keu pusat komersial, ka jiato peurdagangan rayek ngön jilingka lé gunong gunong.
hypothesis: Sidroe banda jameun di Smyrna, jinoe ka jeuet keu pusat komersial nyang modern, maju, dan rame, nyang na di seukeulileng teluk raya dan dikeulileng lé gunong-gunong.

source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
reference: Jalan rayek nyang luah, rumoh binteh kaca ngön pusat beulanja moderen nyang dipungui deungön ubong mirah, pasai abad keu-18, seumeujid tuha ngön geureja, adak pih kuta nyoe keuadaanjih lebeh teurasa Eropa Mediterranean daripada meuTurki.
hypothesis: Buleuen-buleuen luah, bangunan-bangunan nyang meubantuek kaca ngen pusat perbelanjaan modern dipeuget deungen atap-atap teuliti merah tradisional, pasar abad keu-18, ngen mesjid-meuseujid jameun ngen gereja, meskipun kota na atmosfer leubeh dari Eropa Mediterania daripada Turki tradisional.

source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
reference: Gampong Hardarsvik deuh peumandangan toe pulo Eysturoy ngön saboh geureja lapan boh sagoe nyang langka.
hypothesis: Desa Haldarsvík na pandangan ke pulau Eysturoy nyang na di deungen nyan dan na geudong geudong lapan sagoe nyang hana biasa.

source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
reference: Bak leun geureja, hinan na patong mirahpati marmar nyang lagak diateuh padit padum boh kubu.
hypothesis: Di kuburan, na patung marmer yang menarik dari merpati di ateueh na kuburan.

source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
reference: Beuna watèe meu siteungoeh jeum meunyoe tasaweu bak gampong lagak nyan.
hypothesis: Meureutoh sitengguam untuk meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak meujak di gampong nyang meujamangat.

source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
reference: U bahgian baroh ngön mangat ta jangkau nyan keuh kuta Sintra nyang lagak ngön meunawan até ngön nyan keuh meusyeuhu bak ureueng luwa lhueh akun nyang meucahya meugah nyan jipeugot lé Lord Byron.
hypothesis: Di utara dan di dalam jangkauan mudah adalah kota romantis dan meugah Sintra dan yang jeut keu terkenal keu ureung luwa setelah laporan yang bersinar tentang keindahan jih yang dicatet le Lord Byron.

source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
reference: Scotturb Bus 403 dijak sabèe u Sintra, didong di Capo da Raca.
hypothesis: Bus Scotturb 403 berei secara teratur u Sintra, berhenti di Cabo da Roca.

source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
reference: Na sit u baroh jak saweu teumpat suci ureueng inong Fatima (kuil), deuh takalon Mariah nyang meusyehu ban sigom dônya.
hypothesis: Meunan cit di utara jak u Peureumahan Agung Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), saboh teumpat penampakan Marian yang terkenal di seumeusta.

source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
reference: Neu ingat bahawasanjih droe neuh neujak kalon kubu ureueng ramé, lage situs nyang karap hana ék takira keu sibahgian rayek ureung di dônya.
hypothesis: Mohon ingat bahwa awak nyan seucara utô awak nyan geujak u saboh teumpat kubu massal, meunan cit saboh teumpat nyang na makna nyang hana jeulaih keu saboh bagian rayek populasi donya.

source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
reference: Hinan manteng na padit droe ureung inong ngön ureung agam nyang udép nyang seulamat sampoe jinoe, ngön na padum droe ureueng-ureung nyang geu gaseh ka dipoh atawa geukeurija sampoe matèe geuh hinan, yahudi ngön kon yahudi saban.
hypothesis: Mantong na le that ureuëng agam ngon ureuëng inong nyang udeb nyang ka lheueh udeb di teumpat nyoe, dan le that nyang na ureuëng nyang jicinta nyang jipoh maté atawa jipeuphon peumeurintahan di teumpat nyan, bah kheueh nyan ureuëng Yahudi meunan cit nyang kon Yahudi.

source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
reference: Neutulông jaga situs nyan ngön harkat, martabat ngön hormat. Bèk neumeuayang tentang Holokaus atawa Nazi.
hypothesis: Mohon neutap situs nyoe deungon martabat, keukayaan dan rasa hormat nyang patot. Bék neupeugah haba gura-gura keuhai Holocaust atawa Nazi.

source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
reference: Bèk peureuloh situs deungön taboh tanda atawa ta ceu-ceu grafiti lam peuneuduek.
hypothesis: Bék peusakét situs nyan deungon cara meupeutanda atawa geucrat grafiti u struktur.

source: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
reference: Basa reusmi Barcelona nyan keuh basa catalan ngön basa Spanyol. Sang ladom na nyang brat galak meututo basa catalan, ladom jai nyang meuphom basa nyan, ngön karab mandum ureueng geuteupue basa Spanyol.
hypothesis: Bahsa resmi Barcelona nakeuh Catalan ngen Spanyol. Kira-kira siteng leubeh galak geumeututoe Catalan, mayoritas rayek muphom nyan, dan hampir mandum ureuëng jiteupeu Spanyol.

source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
reference: Adakpih, ladom jai tanda dipeutunyok lam basa catalan sabab nyan ka jiteutapkan lé hukôm seubagoe basa reusmi nyang keu phôn.
hypothesis: Namun, leuh tanda-tanda nyan ditandai hanya dalam bahasa Catalan karena nyan ditetepkan le hukom seubagai bahasa resmi phon.

source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
reference: Basa Spanyol pih jai jipaké bak angkotan umum ngön fasilitas nyang laén sit.
hypothesis: Teuma, bahsa Spanyol cit that-that dipakek bak transportasi umum ngon fasilitas laen.

source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
reference: Peungumuman bak Metro sabèe jipeugoet lam basa Catalan, tapi na gangguan nyang hana ireuncanakan lé sistem otomatih jitamong dumpue basa lage basa spanyol, basa Inggreh, basa Prancis, basa Arab ngön basa Jeupang.
hypothesis: Pengumuman biasa di Metro dipeuget hanya lam bahasa Catalan, tapi gangguan nyang hana di rancang dipeugah le sistem otomatis lam padum boh basa termasuk Spanyol, Inggreh, Prancis, Arab ngen Jepang.

source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
reference: Ureueng Paris na wibawa seubagoe ureueng nyang, egosentris, gasa, ngön teukaboe.
hypothesis: Parisians na reputasi seubagoe egocentric, kasar dan sombong.

source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
reference: Seumeuntara nyoe kayem sit na saboh peunilaian nyang hana akurat, cara nyang get nak bèk karu di Paris nyan keuh beu get akai, ta pubuet lage sidroe ureung "bien eleve" (jipeurayek deungön get). Nyan keuh nyan nyang peugot peurjalanan nyang jioh jeut keu mudah.
hypothesis: Meunyo nyoe seubab stereotip nyang hana teupat, cara nyang paleng jroh keu ta get lam Paris mantong na kheueh ta meu-alah ngon cara nyang paleng jroh, ta meu-alah lagee ureueng nyang "bien élevé" (teulaku ngon teulaku).

source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
reference: Urueng luwa Paris lam sigra seumeungeup meunyoe ta peuleumah padit-padit boh asai keusopanan.
hypothesis: Rupa luwa Paris yang hana teukira akan meucre seucara cepat jika awak peuleumah na sileupah-leupah keubahgiaan.

source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
reference: Taman nasional danou Plitvice uteun nyang leuhu, keu phôn that deungön pasi, bak-bak ceumara, nyang deuh meujampue vegetasi Alpin ngön Mediterania.
hypothesis: Taman nasional Tasik Plitvice na hutan leubèh, terutama deungen buk, sawit, ngen pohon pin, ngen na campuran vegetasi Alpine ngen Mediterania.

source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
reference: Nyan na komunitah bak kayèe meubagoe rupa sabab jangkauan iklim mikro, tanoh nyang meubeda, ngön meubagoe tingkatan.
hypothesis: Jih na saboh komunitas tumbuhan yang lubeh rayek, kareuna rentang iklim mikro, beda tanoh ngon tingkat ketinggian yang bervariasi.

source: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
reference: Wilayah nyan sit na rumoh keu meubagoe meulatang ngön ticem.
hypothesis: Wilayah nyan cit na rumoh keu spesies binatang dan cicém nyang sangat lahe.

source: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
reference: Fauna langka lagèe cagee Eropa wareuna coklat, seurigala, kleung, jampok, lynx, miong garong, ngön capercaillie ta tumèe hinan, ngön mandum jeuneh nyang leubéh umum
hypothesis: fauna langka lage beruang coklat Eropa, serigala, elang, ulet, lynx, kucing liar dan capercaillie jeut meurumpok disinan, seurta le spesies biasa

source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
reference: Watèe jak kalon biara, ureung inong diyue sok rok nyang teutop tuot ngön teutop baho sit.
hypothesis: Watee geujak u monastik, inong-inong dipakek keu geungui rok nyang geutôb lutot dan geubalot bahô jih cit.

source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
reference: Ladom jai awak biara sit jipeusiap ija keu ureueng inong nyang jak hana peursiapan, tapi meunyoe neumè keudroe, nyang wareuna nyang trang, droeneuh dipeukhem lé biksu atawa biksuni bak pinto tamong.
hypothesis: Leubeh le biara na bungkusan keu inong nyang teuka hana siap, tapi meunyoe awak geuba awak keudroe, terutama nyang na warna-warni trang, awak nyan teuma meuteumé senyum dari biarawan atawa biarawan bak pintoe.

source: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
reference: Meunan sit sama, ureueng agam diyue sok siluweu panyang beu teutop tuot.
hypothesis: Seubalek jih, agam-agam dipakek untuk dipakek celana nyang meukabong lutut.

source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
reference: Nyoe pih jeut neulake siat bak pinto tamong, tapi bajèe hana dirah lheuh padit-padit droe ureung sok sampoe droe neuh mungkén meurasa hana mangat neu sok rok nyan. Saboh ukuran jeut sok keu mandum ureung agam!
hypothesis: Meunan cit nyoe jeut dipinjam nibak stok di babah pintoe tapi peukayan nyan hana di cuci le lheuh tieb-tieb pengguna jadi awak nyan mungken hana nyaman bak geungui rok nyoe.

source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
reference: Masakan Majorcan, lage daerah nyang saban di Mediterania, asai jih ruti, gule, ngön sie (khusus jih sie bui) ngön iboh minyeuk zaitun bak mandum bahgian jih.
hypothesis: Masakan Mallorca, lage nyang di zona serupa di Mediterania, didasarkan bak ruti, sayuran ngen daging (khusus jih daging babi), dan dipakek minyak zaitun lam mandum.

source: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
reference: Pajoh bu malam nyang seudeurhana ngön paléng geuturi, khusohjih watèe musem suum, nyan keuh Pa amb Oli, ruti ngön minyeuk zaitun, boh tomat ngön bumbue pue-pue nyang na lage keju, eungkot tuna atawa nyan laén.
hypothesis: Saboh malam biasa, terutama bak masa musém panas, nakeuh Pa amb Oli: Roti ngon minyéuk zaiton, tomat, dan bôh-bôh nyang na lage keju, ikan tuna, dll.

source: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
reference: Mandum kata benda, asai sajan kata Sie keu droe neuh, sabèe jimulai deungön huruh rayek, bahpih bak teungoh-teungoh kalimat.
hypothesis: Bandum istilah, seulaen kata Sie keu awak, sabe dimulai deungon huruf kapital, bahkan di teungoh kalimat.

source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
reference: Nyoe keuh cara penteng keu peubeda antara padum boh kata keureja ngön objek.
hypothesis: Nyoe adalah cara yang peunteng untuk membeda antara padum boh kata kerja ngen objek.

source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
reference: Hai nyan keuh jeut takhen nyang peugot meubaca leubéh mangat, bahpih teumuleh bacut payah sabab peureulé ta tupeue pue nyan kata keureja atawa kata sipheut nyan jipaké lam beuntok kata nyang seubetoijih.
hypothesis: Meunyo cit jeut ji peuget baca leubeh mudah, meskipun tulisan jeut agak rumit kareuna keu ta teumeu peu kata kata atau kata sifat dipakek dalam bentuk substansi.

source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
reference: Peulafai basa Italia leubéh mudah sabab jai kata nyang jikhen hie lage deungön nyang jituleh
hypothesis: Pengucapan bahasa Italia nyan relatif mudah kareuna le kata-kata diucapkan lagee nyan

source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
reference: Huruh nyang beu meuleuhen-luehen c ngön g, sabab peulafai huruh nyan meumacam bagoe kiban huruh vokal aleuhjih.
hypothesis: Huruf utama yang harus diperhatikan adalah c dan g, kareuna pengucapan jih meubeda-beda berdasarkan vokal berikut.

source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
reference: Pih, buena tapeuteuntèe keu peulafai r ngön rr deungön cara meubeda: caro meumakna gaseh, meusu carro meumakna moto.
hypothesis: Meunan cit, pastikan keu neupeutrang r ngon rr beda: caro berarti dear, sedangkan carro berarti karet.

source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
reference: Basa Persia leubéh mudah ngön bacut meuatô.
hypothesis: Bahasa Persia na grammar yeng relatif mudah ngen le jih biasa.

source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
reference: Leubéh nibak nyan, deungön tabaca buku tata basa nyoe meubantu droeneuh meurunoe tata basa Persia ngön meuphom kata leubéh get.
hypothesis: Nyang kheueh sabab jih, meunyoe gata baca bab-bab phon nibak basa Persia nyoe, gata teuma jeuet keu ureuëng nyang leubeh muphom bahsa Persia dan muphom lom jeulaih-jeulaih jih.

source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
reference: Tentejih, meunyoe droeneuh meuphom basa Roman, nyan jeut leubéh mudah keu droeneuh nemeurunoe basa Portugis.
hypothesis: Hana peureulée teupubuet, meunyoe awak nyan na awak nyang meuturi bahasa Romance, awak nyan akan leubeh mudah untuk awak nyan meupelajari bahasa Portugis.

source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
reference: Adak pih, ramé ureueng nyang meuphom bacut basa Spayol mengken jipiké basa Portugis sep hie deungön basa nyan sampoe hana peurlèe lé meurunoe meupisah.
hypothesis: Namun, ureung nyang meuturi bacut bahasa Spanyol mungken langsong meuhimpon bahwa bahasa Portugis nyan that teutap that kureung sampoe hana peureulée teumeurunoe secara terpisah.

source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
reference: Obeservatorium seugohlom moderen nyan biasajih ka meujameun jinoe, ngön teutap seubagoe museum atawa situs peudidek.
hypothesis: Observatorium pra-modern seureng that ka tuha jinoe, dan tetap jeut keu museum, atau situs pendidikan.

source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
reference: Sabab wab brok cahya bak masa jaya nyan kon jeuneh peukara jinoe, wab brok nyan biasajih di kuta-kuta atawa kampus-kampus, leubéh mangat meutume nibak ta peudong bak jameun jinoe.
hypothesis: Karena polusi cahaya bak masa peunaseut jih hana masalah lagee jinoe, awak nyan biasa jih na di kota atau di kampus, leubeh mudah untuk di jak dari yang dibangun bak masa modern.

source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
reference: Jai teleskop peuneuliti moderen nyan keuh teumpat nyang rayek bak dairah-dairah deungön keuadaan cuwaca nyang get.
hypothesis: Leuh teleskop penelitian modern adalah fasilitas rayek di daerah terpencil deungen kondisi atmosfer yeng menguntungkan.

source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
reference: Bungong Ceri, jikheun seubagoe hanami, nyan kajeut keu bahgian nibak reusam Jeupang nibak trep abad keu 8.
hypothesis: Meulaboh bungong ceri, yang diteupeu hanami, ka jeut keu bagian dari budaya Jepang sejak abad ke-8.

source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
reference: Konsep nyan trok nibak Cina, bungong plum seubagoe bungong teulebeh.
hypothesis: Konsep nyan teuka dari Cina di teumpat bungong plum adalah bungong pilihan.

source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
reference: Di Jeupang, Khanduri-khanduri bungong ceri keu phôn geupeugot lé Raja-raja keu droegeuh ngön keu ureueng-ureueng teupandang bak meuligoe.
hypothesis: Di Jepang, pesta bungong ceri phon dipeuget le kaisar hanya untuk droe jih dan anggota-anggota aristokrasi laen di sekitar Istana Kaisar.

source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
reference: Seulaman takalon leubéh get watèe di lingkungan, jadi leubéh itheun godaan keu peugadoh nyan keuh “saboh sagai" jeuneh.
hypothesis: Tumbuhan deuh seuhat seuhat meunyoe lam lingkungan alam, jadi ta lawan godaan untuk tapeusampôh "saboh" pih.

source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
reference: Miseu tajak kalon saboh lampoh geupeugot, peusapat "spesimen" jeut dipubuet gata dipeuteubit, hana jimeuduk.
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak nyan jak u taman nyang ka dipeugot secara formal, awak nyan teuma geu ekseuh "conto" nyan, hana meudiskusi.

source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
reference: Singapura bak umumjih nakeuh teumpat nyang aman keu tajak kalon ngön mudah that takalon arah, ngön gata jeut bloe karap mandum watèe troh.
hypothesis: Singapura umum jih saboh teumpat yang sangat aman untuk di tinggai dan sangat mudah untuk di navigasi, dan awak jeut meukat hampir peue mantong wate awak nyan trok.

source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
reference: Tapi kareuna diduk di "tropis manyang" padum deurajat sagai di baroh khatulistiwa gata payah tatheun suum (sabèe) ngön mata uroe tarek (watèe langet trang, leubéh jareung).
hypothesis: Tapi dikandak di "tropik tinggi" bacut derajat utara khatulistiwa awak nyan akan perlu untuk meupeuget haba (seways) dan matahari yang kuat (wanita langet hana le, leubeh jarang).

source: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
reference: Na cit padum boh bus dijak u baroh u Hebron, teumpat kubu tradisional ureueng Alkitab Abraham, Ishak, Yakub, ngön peureumoh ureungnyan.
hypothesis: Na cit bacut bis nyang jak u utara u Hebron, teumpat nyang ka ji kubu lé indatu Alkitab, Nabi Ibrahim, Nabi Ishaq, Nabi Yakub, dan peurumoh-peurumoh awaknyan.

source: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
reference: Tapeuteuntèe bus nyang keuneuk gata ék u Herbon ngön kon, toe that deungön peumukiman Yahudi Kiryat Arba.
hypothesis: Peuget kheueh peucen bahwa bas nyang gata pike keu gata jak u Hebron dan kon mantong u gampông Yahudi di Kiryat Arba.

source: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
reference: Peurairan peudalaman jeut keu tema nyang get keu asai jak meuramien.
hypothesis: Jalur-jalur ie dalam negeri jeut jeut tema yang get untuk geupeudong liburan di sekitar.

source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
reference: Miseujih tajak kalon kastil di Panton Loire, Panton Rhine, atawa meulaôt u teumpat-teumpat nyang get di Danube atawa ék jaloe ban saboh Kanal Erie.
hypothesis: Miseu jih jak u kuta di Lembah Loire, Lembah Rhine atawa jak u kota-kota menarik di Danube atawa meulayeu di seulatan kanal Erie.

source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
reference: Awak nyan pih geupegah rute meusyeuhu jak deungön aki ngön ék itangen.
hypothesis: Awaknyan cit meupeutrang rot untuk trek populer ngen peuterung.

source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
reference: Natal nakeuh salah saboh uroe raya peunteng keu ureueng kristen, geurayakan sebagoe uroe lahèe Yesus.
hypothesis: Natal nakeuh saboh nibak uroe raya nyang paleng peunteng lam agama Kristen, dan geupeuna seubagai uroe ulang thon Isa.

source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
reference: Na padum boh tradisi di seulingka liburan nyan jitirèe ureueng non-Kristen di nanggroe-nanggroe Kristen ngön ureung non-Kristen ban sigom dônya.
hypothesis: Le that tradisi nyang jikeulileng uroe raya nyan ka di angkat cit le ureung hana meuiman di nanggroe Kristen ngen ureung hana Kristen di seulama donya.

source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
reference: Na tradisi keu peu leupah malam Paskah deungön meujaga bak padum boh titek teuhah keneuk kalon mata uroe teubit.
hypothesis: Na tradisi untuk ta peuseuleusoe malam Paskah hana jipiôh di teumpat nyang teuhah keu ta kalon uroe jiteubiet.

source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
reference: Teuntèe na peunjelasan teologis kristen keu tradisi nyoe, tapi nyoe jeut keu musem seumi Pra-Kristen ngön ritual keusuburan.
hypothesis: Na tentu jih na penjelasan teologi Kristen untuk tradisi nyoe, tapi mungken nyan ritual Musim semi dan Keukayaan sigohlom Kristen.

source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
reference: Geureja-geureja nyang leubéh tradisional kayem geupeugöt malam Paskah nibak Sabtu malam bak akhe peukan Paskah, deungön jamaat kayem peumeuriah peurayaan bak teungoh malam keu geurayakan keubangkitan Kristus.
hypothesis: Geurja-geurja tradisional nyang leubeh that geupeuna Hari Raya Paskah bak malam Sabtu bak malam minggu Paskah, deungon seurema- seurema seurema seurema bak uroe raya nyan bak malam uroe keu geupeuna uroe raya kebangkitan Almaseh.

source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
reference: Mandum meulatang nyang phônjih troh u pulo-pulo jak keuno deungön meulangue, dipo atawa meuapong.
hypothesis: Bandum binatang nyang phon that trok u pulo-pulo nyoe teuka keunoe deungen meulampah, meu meulayang atawa meuambang.

source: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
reference: Sabab jarak nyang jioh dari beunua, mamalia han jeut dijak makajih baneng raksasa jeut keu meulatang geumbala nyang phôn di Galapagos.
hypothesis: Kareuna jarak nyang luwah dari benua mamalia hana jeut keu perjalanan yang jeut keu penyu raksasa binatang meurabe utama di Galapagos.

source: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
reference: Seujak dijak ureung u Galapagos, lë mamalia ka geupeuturi teumasok kameng, guda, leumo, tikoh, miong, ngön asèe.
hypothesis: Sejak teuka manusia u Galapagos, le mamalia ka di peutamong termasuk kambing, guda, lembu, tikus, kucing ngen anjing.

source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
reference: Miseu gata jak u daerah Arktik atawa Antartika bak musem leupie ka tarasa malam kutub, nyang meumakna matauroe hana diteubit di ateuh cakrawala.
hypothesis: Meunyo awak jak u wilayah Arktik atawa Antartika bak musém musém deungön awak nyan akan na pengalaman malam polar, yang ateuh arti bahwa mata uroe hana jiangkat di ateuh cakrawala.

source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
reference: Nyoe nakeuh keusempatan nyang get kalon Aurora borealis, kareuna langet ka supot sabèe.
hypothesis: Nyo na kesempatan yang get untuk kalon Aurora borealis, seubab langet akan gelap leubeh bacut seureuta jam.

source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
reference: Kareuna daerah nyoe jareung na peunduduk, polusi hana jeut keu masalah, gata jeut mangat bak mata teuh deuh bintang-bintang.
hypothesis: Karena daerah nyan hana le penduduk, dan polusi cahaya seureng hana masalah, awak pih akan jeut menikmati bintang-bintang.

source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
reference: Budaya keureuja Jeupang leubéh hirarkis ngön formal daripada nyang biasa dipubuet lé awak Barat.
hypothesis: Budaya kerja Jepang leubeh hiérarkis dan formal daripada nyang jeut ji gunakan oleh ureung Barat.

source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
reference: Jas nakeuh bajèe bisnis nyang standar, ngön rakan keureuja saleng sapa nan keuluarga atawa nan jabatan.
hypothesis: Suit adalah pakaian bisnis standar, dan rekan kerja saling memanggil seucara surname atau seucara judul pekerjaan.

source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
reference: Keuharmonisan teumpat keureuja seb brat peunteng, leubéh penteng keurija grup daripada geupujoe keurija sidroe-droe ureueng.
hypothesis: Harmoni di teumpat kerja nyan that peunteng, teutam usaha kelompok daripada pujoe pencapaian individu.

source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
reference: Ureung keureuja suah dijok keuseupakatan ureueng rayek awak nyan keu mandum keuputusan nyang awak nyan peugot, ngön beu dipateh keu intruksi ureueng rayek awaknyan, bèk na tanyong-teumanyong.
hypothesis: Peuget pekerja seureng meukem izin dari peugawée awak jih untuk peue mantong keputusan yang awak nyan peuget, dan awak nyan diharapkan untuk taat bak peugawée awak nyan tanpa ragu.
